rules.title: Do not disable focus without a keyboard path
rules.message: Focusable="False", IsTabStop="False" or TabNavigation="None" leave pointer-only controls. Make sure the action is reachable by keyboard (HotKey or another focusable element).

rules.title: Pointer-only handlers on non-focusable elements
rules.message: Tapped/PointerPressed on Border, Grid, TextBlock or Image makes an element clickable but not focusable. Prefer a Button (flat style) or add Focusable plus key handling. Rows inside a ListBox item template are fine (the list handles the keyboard).

rules.title: Custom focus-visible style without FocusAdorner reset
rules.message: When you style :focus-visible yourself, set FocusAdorner to {x:Null}, otherwise two indicators appear. Never remove the border on :focus without a replacement indicator.

rules.title: Placeholder contrast
rules.message: Placeholder text renders at 50 percent opacity. Raise TextControlPlaceholderOpacity or set PlaceholderForeground if contrast is too low.
rules.bad: default opacity, grey placeholder on light grey

rules.title: Slider with a 0-1 range and default step sizes
rules.message: SmallChange defaults to 1 and LargeChange to 10. For small ranges set SmallChange/LargeChange (for example 0.01/0.1) so keyboard users can reach values.

rules.title: Read-only slider via IsHitTestVisible
rules.message: IsHitTestVisible="False" blocks only the pointer; the slider stays keyboard focusable. Use a ProgressBar for display, or also set Focusable="False".

rules.title: Transition type does not match the property type
rules.message: A transition must match the property type: IBrush needs BrushTransition, Thickness ThicknessTransition, CornerRadius CornerRadiusTransition, BoxShadows BoxShadowsTransition, double DoubleTransition, ITransform TransformOperationsTransition.

rules.title: WPF transform types cannot be transitioned
rules.message: RotateTransform, ScaleTransform etc. are not transitionable. To animate with TransformOperationsTransition set the transform in the CSS-style format (rotate(45deg)) and give it a start value first.

rules.title: Hover or pressed feedback as keyframe animation
rules.message: A keyframe animation under a conditional selector stops abruptly when the selector stops matching (no smooth way back). For reversible state feedback use Setters plus Transitions.

rules.title: Animation without Duration
rules.message: Every Animation needs a Duration (h:mm:ss). Without it nothing runs.

rules.title: Animation without FillMode
rules.message: Without FillMode (default None) the value jumps back when the animation ends. Use Forward or Both to keep the end state, Backward when a delayed animation should show its start value early.

rules.title: PlaybackDirection and PlaybackBehavior values swapped
rules.message: PlaybackDirection is Normal, Reverse, Alternate or AlternateReverse; PlaybackBehavior is Auto, Always or OnlyIfVisible. The table in animations.md swaps them, do not copy it.

rules.title: PlaybackBehavior=Always keeps animations running when hidden
rules.message: The default Auto pauses keyframe animations on invisible controls and saves CPU; Always keeps running. Avoid Always on endless animations, and give every endless animation an app-level switch for reduced motion.

rules.title: RunAsync without CancellationToken
rules.message: For an endless animation (IterationCount infinite) RunAsync never completes unless a CancellationToken is passed or the target leaves the visual tree. Pass a token; finite animations need none.

rules.title: Animation resource without x:SetterTargetType
rules.message: An Animation defined as a resource needs both x:Key and x:SetterTargetType so its setters know the target type.

rules.title: Unknown easing name or WPF easing class
rules.message: Valid names are LinearEasing and {Sine|Quadratic|Cubic|Quartic|Quintic|Exponential|Circular|Back|Bounce|Elastic}Ease{In|Out|InOut}. WPF classes (CubicEase, EasingFunction=) do not exist. Easing is set on Animation, KeyFrame (KeySpline) or the transition.

rules.title: Overshooting or playful easing
rules.message: Back and Elastic overshoot the 0..1 range (Opacity above 1, negative sizes); Bounce and Elastic are for playful effects. Use CubicEaseOut for fades and slide-in, CubicEaseIn for slide-out, SineEaseOut for hover.

rules.title: Composition animations: visual access, names, keyframes
rules.message: ElementComposition.GetElementVisual() can return null (control not attached): call after attach/Loaded and check. Composition (StartAnimation, ImplicitAnimations) is for programmatic or performance-critical cases; style-driven feedback belongs in Transitions and keyframes. Keyframe progress is 0..1.
rules.good: var v = ElementComposition.GetElementVisual(c); if (v is null) return; v.StartAnimation("Offset", a);

rules.title: DispatcherTimer with frame-time interval
rules.message: A timer with a frame-length interval (about 16 ms) as an animation loop is the counter-pattern. Use TopLevel.RequestAnimationFrame for UI-thread frame updates or a CompositionCustomVisualHandler for render-thread loops.
rules.bad: var t = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(16) };

rules.title: Animation setter on WPF-style transform property
rules.message: Setter Property="ScaleTransform.ScaleX" (or TranslateTransform.X, RotateTransform.Angle) works only when the target declares a RenderTransform of exactly that type. The documentation examples are inconsistent; alternative: CSS-style transform plus TransformOperationsTransition.
rules.bad: <Setter Property="ScaleTransform.ScaleX" Value="1.1"/> on a Border without RenderTransform

rules.title: OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted without base call
rules.message: OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted must call base.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted() (as the last statement).

rules.title: Program without BuildAvaloniaApp
rules.message: Program needs public static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp(); the XAML previewer and headless tests rely on it. Ignore if it is defined in App.axaml.cs.
rules.bad: class Program { static int Main(string[] args) => 0; }
rules.good: class Program { static int Main(string[] args) => 0; public static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp() => AppBuilder.Configure<App>(); }

rules.title: AppBuilder without logging
rules.message: BuildAvaloniaApp should enable logging (LogToTrace, LogToTextWriter, LogToDelegate or a custom Logger.Sink). Verbose or Debug levels belong in Debug builds only.

rules.title: No global unhandled-exception handling
rules.message: A production desktop app handles Dispatcher.UIThread.UnhandledException, TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException (call SetObserved), AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException and wraps StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime in try/catch/finally (log and flush only, no recovery).
rules.bad: class Program { static int Main(string[] a) => BuildAvaloniaApp().StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(a); }
rules.good: class Program { static int Main(string[] a) { Dispatcher.UIThread.UnhandledException += OnUnhandled; return BuildAvaloniaApp().StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(a); } }

rules.title: Handled = true in UnhandledException needs logging
rules.message: Handled = true suppresses the crash. The handler must log the exception and may continue only when no inconsistent state (half-saved data) is possible. Use UnhandledExceptionFilter for expected types.

rules.title: ViewModel assembled by hand with nested new
rules.message: Build the ServiceProvider once in OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted and resolve the ViewModel with GetRequiredService; do not wire services together with nested new.

rules.title: DI registration must match the consumed type
rules.message: If a constructor asks for IBusinessService, register AddX<IBusinessService, BusinessService>(); AddTransient<BusinessService>() does not resolve the interface.

rules.title: Blocking wait on a task (GetResult, Wait)
rules.message: Never block the UI thread with .Wait(), .Result or .GetAwaiter().GetResult(): deadlock risk and a frozen window. Use await; run heavy work with Task.Run. Fine in Main on the command-line path and in tests.

rules.title: No UI or bound-collection access from background threads
rules.message: Controls and bound ObservableCollections change only on the UI thread. Load data in the background, assign after the await or post with Dispatcher.UIThread.Post/InvokeAsync. ConfigureAwait(false) in ViewModel code that then changes UI state breaks the return to the UI thread.
rules.bad: await Task.Run(() => { foreach (var i in list) Items.Add(i); });
rules.good: var data = await Task.Run(Load); Items = new ObservableCollection<Item>(data);

rules.title: Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher
rules.message: Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher returns the dispatcher of the calling thread; on a pool thread that is a new, useless one. Use Dispatcher.UIThread.Post (fire and forget) or InvokeAsync. Event handlers already run on the UI thread.

rules.title: Pool-thread timer in UI code
rules.message: System.Timers.Timer and System.Threading.Timer call back on pool threads. A timer that changes UI or bound properties must be a DispatcherTimer (Tick runs on the UI thread). Ignore if the callback does not touch UI state.
rules.good: var t = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1) };

rules.title: x:DataType points at a design-time class
rules.message: x:DataType must name the production view model; design data comes in through d:DataContext. Binding to a design class breaks the real view at runtime.

rules.title: Previewer size set as Width/Height on a UserControl
rules.message: Give the previewer a size with d:DesignWidth/d:DesignHeight (and mc:Ignorable="d"), not Width/Height on the UserControl, which also applies at runtime.

rules.title: Resources indexer read from code
rules.message: Resources["key"] does not search merged dictionaries or parents. Use TryFindResource(key, ActualThemeVariant, out value) (or GetResourceObservable for runtime changes).

rules.title: Generated ResX class is internal
rules.message: {x:Static lang:Resources.Key} needs a public Resources class. Use PublicResXFileCodeGenerator (Visual Studio) or MSBuild:Compile with <PublicClass>true</PublicClass>. Ignore if the class is never used from XAML.

rules.title: double/decimal/float parse without a culture
rules.message: Parse and ToString follow the thread culture, which is right for user input. For storage, protocols and exchange formats pass CultureInfo.InvariantCulture explicitly.

rules.title: StringFormat starting with a placeholder
rules.message: A StringFormat that starts with {0 needs the {} prefix, otherwise the parser reads a markup extension: StringFormat='{}{0:C}'.

rules.title: ShowDialog without owner
rules.message: ShowDialog needs the owner window and returns a Task: await dialog.ShowDialog<T>(owner). Return values go through Close(value). Avalonia has no MessageBox; build a dialog window and show it with ShowDialog(owner).

rules.title: Async Closing handler cannot cancel
rules.message: e.Cancel = true must be set synchronously in Closing/OnClosing; an await before it is too late because the window is already closing. Cancel first, ask asynchronously, then call Close() again after confirmation.
rules.bad: Closing += async (s, e) => { if (await Ask()) e.Cancel = true; };

rules.title: Restoring window position
rules.message: Position is in pixels, Width/Height in DIPs. Before restoring, check against Screens.All / ScreenFromPoint that the point is still on a monitor; a >= 0 test is wrong (monitors left of the main one have negative coordinates). Save WindowState separately and save in Closed, not in a cancellable OnClosing.
rules.bad: if (s.Left >= 0 && s.Top >= 0) Position = new PixelPoint(s.Left, s.Top);
rules.good: if (screens.ScreenFromPoint(saved) is not null) Position = saved;

rules.title: Removed v11 window decoration API
rules.message: These v11 members are gone in 12.1: use Window.WindowDecorations (Full, BorderOnly, None), ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint with WindowDrawnDecorations, and WindowDecorationProperties.ElementRole.

rules.title: ListBox, DataGrid or TreeView inside a ScrollViewer
rules.message: Virtualization needs a bounded height. A ListBox/DataGrid directly inside a StackPanel (infinite height) or ScrollViewer realizes every item. Put it in a Grid row with * or a DockPanel fill.

rules.title: Search or filter runs synchronously on every keystroke
rules.message: A change handler for a search or filter text should not run a database query or heavy filter synchronously on every keystroke. Debounce (CancellationTokenSource plus Task.Delay) and use Task.Run for heavy work. In-memory filters of small lists are fine.
rules.bad: partial void OnSearchTextChanged(string value) => Rows = Db.Query(value);

rules.title: DevTools attached outside Debug builds
rules.message: AttachDevTools()/WithDeveloperTools() belongs under #if DEBUG so release builds do not ship the developer tools.

rules.title: Icon-only button without accessible name
rules.message: Icon-only or image-only buttons give a screen reader no text. Set AutomationProperties.Name (or LabeledBy) on the button. Inputs without a visible label and ambiguous labels need it too.

rules.title: Interactive control removed from the tab order
rules.message: Interactive controls must be reachable with Tab. Do not set Focusable="False" or IsTabStop="False" on them; provide a keyboard-reachable alternative. Fine for decoration.

rules.title: Clickable container instead of a Button
rules.message: A Border, Grid or TextBlock with PointerPressed is not a button for a screen reader and has no keyboard access. Use a Button, or set AutomationProperties.ControlTypeOverride="Button" plus a Name and add keyboard handling.

rules.title: Manual DataValidators removal (obsolete in 12)
rules.message: Since Avalonia 12 the DataAnnotations plugin is off by default, so removing it by hand is redundant and can be deleted. ViewModels with [Required] on plain properties need .WithDataAnnotationsValidation(); ObservableValidator/INotifyDataErrorInfo need no plugin.

rules.title: DllImport or ComImport instead of source-generated interop
rules.message: For trimming and Native AOT use [LibraryImport] in partial classes and [GeneratedComInterface] instead of [DllImport] and [ComImport] (marshalling at compile time). Existing DllImport with complex marshalling may stay deliberately. Check the HWND descriptor before using a window handle.

rules.title: Native control hosts sit above the Avalonia surface
rules.message: NativeControlHost and web views are drawn above Avalonia content: no transparency, no transforms, no popups, flyouts or overlays above them. Check the area around such hosts manually.
rules.bad: <NativeControlHost/> with a ToolTip or Popup over it
rules.good: keep overlays outside the hosted area

rules.title: InvokeScript without await
rules.message: NativeWebView.InvokeScript is asynchronous; await it, otherwise errors are lost. Messages from JavaScript arrive through WebMessageReceived.

rules.title: Desktop project not WinExe
rules.message: The desktop startup project uses OutputType WinExe, otherwise Windows shows a console window next to the app. Ignore for libraries and tools.

rules.title: Business logic in code-behind handlers
rules.message: The tutorial uses Click/TextChanged handlers only for learning. In an MVVM app logic and state belong in the ViewModel (Command, bindings, CanExecute). Pure view actions without business logic are fine.

rules.title: x:DataType missing for compiled bindings
rules.message: Avalonia 12 compiles bindings by default and needs a data type. Set x:DataType on the root (Window/UserControl), give every DataTemplate its own DataType/x:DataType, or put DataType on the binding.

rules.title: Compiled bindings switched off
rules.message: Turning compiled bindings off is not recommended: binding errors move from build time to run time. Remove the setting and mark the few dynamic bindings as {ReflectionBinding ...}.

rules.title: ReflectionBinding or string-path binding
rules.message: ReflectionBinding is meant for dynamic paths only; it moves errors to run time and does not suit trimming or Native AOT. Use {Binding ...} with x:DataType, or CompiledBinding.Create in code.

rules.title: Unnecessary DataContext cast in binding path
rules.message: The compiler infers the type for #Name.DataContext.X and $parent[T].DataContext.X. The explicit cast ((vm:T)DataContext) is only needed when inference fails.

rules.title: Binding parameter set through a nested binding
rules.message: Mode, Converter, ConverterParameter, StringFormat, FallbackValue, TargetNullValue, Delay and Source are fixed when the binding is created; a nested {Binding} inside them is not resolved. Use a MultiBinding instead.

rules.title: FindAncestor RelativeSource instead of $parent[...]
rules.message: The short syntax $parent[Type;n].Prop works in the logical tree; RelativeSource FindAncestor works in the visual tree and is not the same. Mixing them is error-prone, and ancestor lookups inside DataTemplates add binding errors and cost. Prefer $parent[...] or an inherited attached property.

rules.title: Command bound to a method instead of an ICommand
rules.message: Method binding is allowed but follows its own rules (overload resolution, CanXxx(object?) convention, no CanExecuteChanged). With CommunityToolkit.Mvvm use [RelayCommand] and bind XxxCommand.

rules.title: CommandParameter given as the string True/False
rules.message: CommandParameter is typed object, so "True" stays a string and a bool parameter fails with a cast error when the command runs. Write boolean literals as {x:True} or {x:False}.

rules.title: Observable subscriptions are never disposed
rules.message: Bind(...) and Subscribe(...) return an IDisposable and observables hold no weak references. Keep the subscription and dispose it (OnDetachedFromVisualTree, ViewModel Dispose or a CompositeDisposable). GetObservable fires immediately with the current value.

rules.title: Task property that starts a new task on every read
rules.message: A property used as {Binding X^} must return one stored Task<T>. A getter such as '=> LoadAsync()' starts a new task on every read. Assign the task once and raise PropertyChanged to refresh.

rules.title: Task/observable binding (^) without FallbackValue
rules.message: Task and observable bindings produce nothing until the first value arrives (empty control, layout jump). Set FallbackValue. Errors inside the task never reach the UI; model the error state in the ViewModel.

rules.title: MultiBinding with TwoWay or OneWayToSource
rules.message: MultiBinding supports only OneWay and OneTime, and IMultiValueConverter has no ConvertBack. Split the target into single bindings or use OneWay.

rules.title: IMultiValueConverter ignores UnsetValue
rules.message: values can contain UnsetValue at startup, and NumericUpDown.Value is decimal?. Return BindingOperations.DoNothing for values that cannot be resolved yet instead of casting or throwing.

rules.title: Own converter for something Avalonia already provides
rules.message: Built in: '!' and '!!' in the binding path, StringConverters.IsNullOrEmpty, ObjectConverters.IsNull, BoolConverters.And/Or. Prefer them over an own converter.

rules.title: Bound collection does not report changes
rules.message: ItemsSource updates at run time only when the collection implements INotifyCollectionChanged (ObservableCollection<T>). A replaced collection needs property change notification, and editable items need INotifyPropertyChanged. List<T>/IEnumerable<T> that is changed after binding does not update the UI.
rules.bad: public List<Person> People { get; } = new(); // later People.Add(...)

rules.title: Bound ViewModel property without change notification
rules.message: Properties that are bound and change at run time must raise PropertyChanged. With CommunityToolkit.Mvvm use [ObservableProperty]; a plain { get; set; } in an ObservableObject does not notify.

rules.title: [ObservableProperty]/[RelayCommand] in a class that is not partial
rules.message: The CommunityToolkit.Mvvm source generator needs a partial class. Without it the generated properties and commands are missing and bindings point at nothing.

rules.title: CanExecute is not re-evaluated
rules.message: Every property CanExecute depends on must notify the command: [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor(nameof(XCommand))] or NotifyCanExecuteChanged(). CommandParameter can be null at startup, so CanExecute(object?) must cope.

rules.title: Bound properties or collections changed off the UI thread
rules.message: PropertyChanged, CanExecuteChanged and changes to bound collections belong on the UI thread (Dispatcher.UIThread.Post/InvokeAsync). The ^ bindings marshal themselves, your own setters do not.

rules.title: CollectionViewSource / ICollectionView does not exist
rules.message: Avalonia has no CollectionViewSource, ICollectionView, ListCollectionView or GroupStyle. Sort, filter and group in the ViewModel (filtered ObservableCollection, DynamicData). DataGrid has its own DataGridCollectionView.

rules.title: Collection cleared and refilled on every change
rules.message: For large lists do not Clear() and re-Add in a loop on every filter or sort change. Update incrementally (DynamicData Filter/Sort/Bind) and expose a ReadOnlyObservableCollection<T>. Small lists do not matter.
rules.bad: Filtered.Clear(); foreach (var p in query) Filtered.Add(p);

rules.title: Search/filter TextBox updates on every key press
rules.message: TextBox.Text pushes to the source on every key press. For search, filter or costly validation add Delay=300 or UpdateSourceTrigger=LostFocus.

rules.title: Literal text starting with { needs the {} escape
rules.message: An attribute value (or StringFormat) that starts with '{' and is not a markup extension must begin with {}. Write StringFormat={}{0:0.0} and Text="{}{0} items".

rules.title: Validation attributes without ObservableValidator
rules.message: DataAnnotations on [ObservableProperty] fields only validate when the class derives from ObservableValidator and the field has [NotifyDataErrorInfo]. Otherwise nothing is validated and the UI shows no error.

rules.title: Form submit without ValidateAllProperties()
rules.message: Fields the user never touched are not validated. The submit action must call ValidateAllProperties() and check HasErrors; couple CanExecute to !HasErrors.

rules.title: Validation by throwing in a property setter
rules.message: Exceptions in setters show an error, but INotifyDataErrorInfo is the recommended way (several errors per property, async). Use [Range]/[NotifyDataErrorInfo] with ObservableValidator.

rules.title: Customised DataValidationErrors hides the error message
rules.message: A replacement Template for DataValidationErrors without an error presenter hides the message from sighted users (screen readers still get it). An ErrorTemplate DataTemplate needs x:DataType="{x:Type x:Object}" with compiled bindings. The border colour comes from the TextBox, not from DataValidationErrors.
rules.good: <!-- keep the error presenter in the template, or use TooltipDataValidationErrors -->

rules.title: Binding path through a nullable intermediate value
rules.message: Paths such as SelectedPerson.Name log binding errors while the intermediate object is null. Use ?. or a FallbackValue.

rules.title: Master-detail: dependent selection is not reset
rules.message: When the parent selection (SelectedCategory) changes, reset the child selection (SelectedItem = null), otherwise the old detail stays visible.
rules.bad: ItemsSource="{Binding SelectedCategory.Items}" without a reset in OnSelectedCategoryChanged
rules.good: partial void OnSelectedCategoryChanged(Category? value) => SelectedItem = null;

rules.title: Verbose binding log or debug FallbackValue left in release
rules.message: Binding errors only go to the trace log, so keep LogToTrace(LogEventLevel.Warning) in BuildAvaloniaApp. Verbose binding logging belongs in debug builds (#if DEBUG), and diagnostic FallbackValues such as 'BINDING FAILED' must not ship.

rules.title: Style classes toggled in code instead of Classes.x binding
rules.message: Bind a class to a bool with Classes.name="{Binding Flag}" (or !Flag) instead of scattering Classes.Add/Remove in code-behind. Custom controls that manage their own state classes are fine.

rules.title: Chart controls used but Avalonia.Controls.Charts not referenced
rules.message: Chart controls (CartesianChart, PieChart, FinancialChart, ComboChart) come from the Avalonia Pro package Avalonia.Controls.Charts. Reference it in the project (version in Directory.Packages.props) or the markup does not load.

rules.title: Object lists bound to chart series need ValuePath
rules.message: A series bound to a list of objects needs CategoryPath and ValuePath (PieSeries: ValuePath and LabelPath). Only lists of double, int, float, decimal or Point work without paths.

rules.title: Chart ratio property outside 0 to 1
rules.message: BarWidth, FillOpacity, SplineTension, InnerRadiusFactor, RadiusFactor, NeckWidth and CandleWidth are ratios from 0 to 1. Values such as 40 or 70% are wrong.

rules.title: Secondary-axis series without ShowSecondaryAxis
rules.message: A series with YAxisPosition="Secondary" needs ShowSecondaryAxis="True" and a SecondaryVerticalAxis on the ComboChart, otherwise it has no axis to scale against.

rules.title: Wrong direction-colour property for the chart type
rules.message: Direction colours are named per type: Candlestick UpFill/DownFill, Heikin-Ashi BullishBrush/BearishBrush, Renko UpBrush/DownBrush, Kagi YangBrush/YinBrush, Point-and-Figure XBrush/OBrush.

rules.title: Technical indicator without TargetSeries
rules.message: SMA, EMA, WMA and Bollinger indicators are computed from a series. TargetSeries defaults to null: bind it, for example TargetSeries="{Binding #PriceSeries}".

rules.title: Enum value not valid for this chart type
rules.message: Value sets differ per chart: LinearGaugeChart.TickPosition Above/Below/Cross, CircularGaugeChart.TickPosition Cross/Inside/Outside, StepLineSeries.StepMode HorizontalFirst/VerticalFirst/Center, PictorialBarSeries.RenderMode Stretch/Clip/Repeat, KpiCard.DeltaType Percentage/Absolute.

rules.title: Marker properties without ShowMarkers
rules.message: On LineSeries, SplineSeries and StepLineSeries ShowMarkers defaults to false and marker styling is only visible when it is true.

rules.title: Axis or plot-area brush on a chart without that surface
rules.message: AxisBrush, GridLineBrush and PlotAreaBackground exist on charts with axes and a plot area (CartesianChart, FinancialChart, CarpetPlot), not on pie, funnel, gauge or KPI charts. Use Background on a container instead.

rules.title: Chart series override TryRenderSelf instead of RenderSeries
rules.message: Custom cartesian series derive from CartesianSeries and implement RenderSeries(in SeriesRenderContext). Move older TryRenderSelf code there.
rules.bad: protected override bool TryRenderSelf(DrawingContext c) => true;
rules.good: protected override void RenderSeries(in SeriesRenderContext context) { }

rules.title: TreeDataGrid without its theme StyleInclude
rules.message: TreeDataGrid renders nothing useful without its theme resources. Add <StyleInclude Source="avares://Avalonia.Controls.TreeDataGrid/Themes/Fluent.axaml"/> to Application.Styles in App.axaml.

rules.title: Avalonia Pro license key committed in clear text
rules.message: TreeDataGrid, PdfViewer, Markdown, RichTextEditor, VirtualKeyboard and the chart controls are Avalonia Pro and need <AvaloniaUILicenseKey/> in the executable project. Do not commit the key: read it from an environment variable or a props file outside the repository, for example Include="$(AVALONIA_LICENSE_KEY)".

rules.title: PdfViewer without its theme StyleInclude
rules.message: PdfViewer cannot render without Default.axaml or Fluent.axaml from Avalonia.Controls.PdfViewer/Themes. Add the matching StyleInclude to App.axaml (Fluent.axaml follows the host FluentTheme).

rules.title: DataGrid without theme StyleInclude (control is deprecated)
rules.message: DataGrid ships in the separate Avalonia.Controls.DataGrid package and needs a StyleInclude that matches the app theme in App.axaml. The docs mark DataGrid as deprecated: prefer TableView for read-only tables and TreeDataGrid for editing.

rules.title: ItemsRepeater is not supported in Avalonia 12
rules.message: ItemsRepeater is no longer supported from Avalonia 12. Use ItemsControl (or ListBox for long lists) or a derived control.

rules.title: ItemsControl and StackPanel neither virtualize nor scroll
rules.message: ItemsControl and StackPanel do not virtualize and have no scrollbar. For long or growing lists bind a ListBox (virtualizing, scrolling) or wrap the content in a ScrollViewer inside a bounded container. Judge by data size.

rules.title: Invalid ListBox SelectionMode value
rules.message: SelectionMode accepts Single, Multiple, Toggle and AlwaysSelected, combinable with a comma (Multiple,Toggle). Values from other frameworks such as Extended are invalid.

rules.title: Scrolling control directly inside a vertical StackPanel
rules.message: A StackPanel gives its children unlimited height, so a ScrollViewer never scrolls and a ListBox, TreeView or DataGrid grows to all items and loses virtualization. Use a Grid with a * row or DockPanel, or set Height/MaxHeight on the child.

rules.title: TreeView ItemTemplate with DataTemplate cannot provide child nodes
rules.message: The child level of a TreeView comes from the item template. Use <TreeDataTemplate ItemsSource="{Binding Children}"> instead of a plain DataTemplate unless the tree is deliberately flat.

rules.title: PageTransition set from a string literal
rules.message: PageTransition is an object property: set it with element syntax (PageSlide, CrossFade, CompositePageTransition) or a resource, and disable it with PageTransition="{x:Null}". A string such as "None" is not a transition.

rules.title: DataGrid AutoGenerateColumns=True
rules.message: AutoGenerateColumns builds headers from property names, which the docs call mostly unsuitable. Declare the columns explicitly.

rules.title: TableViewColumn sets both Binding and CellTemplate
rules.message: CellTemplate takes precedence over Binding, so setting both leaves a dead value. Use one of them.

rules.title: TreeDataGrid v11 API removed or sealed in v12
rules.message: Version 12 removed the generic column types (TextColumn<,> and friends), the Avalonia.Controls.Models.TreeDataGrid namespace and CanUserResizeColumn (now CanUserResize). Build columns with the source helpers, for example source.WithTextColumn(...).
rules.bad: var c = new TextColumn<Country, string>("Name", x => x.Name);

rules.title: TreeDataGrid expander column without ChildrenBinding
rules.message: ChildrenBinding is mandatory on TreeDataGridHierarchicalExpanderColumn. Add ChildrenBinding="{Binding Children}" (HasChildrenBinding enables lazy loading).

rules.title: Invalid TreeDataGrid SelectionMode value
rules.message: The documented values are Row (default), Row,Multiple, Cell and Cell,Multiple. A bare Multiple is not a TreeDataGrid mode.

rules.title: PdfViewer AutoSave without document saving
rules.message: AutoSave only works when AllowDocumentSaving is true. Remove AutoSave or enable saving.

rules.title: PdfViewer buffer outside its valid range
rules.message: PageRenderBuffer accepts 0 to 10 and PageRetentionBuffer 0 to 20; keep retention above render to avoid re-rendering on short scrolls.

rules.title: PdfViewer redaction keeps hidden information
rules.message: RedactionRemovesHiddenInformation defaults to true and also strips structure, thumbnail and metadata. Setting it to false leaves redacted data in the file (privacy risk).

rules.title: PdfViewer format string lost its {0} placeholder
rules.message: PageCountFormat and PageLabelFormat are string.Format patterns and must keep {0}.

rules.title: Label with access key but without Target
rules.message: A Label moves focus only through Target. An underscore access key (_Name, Alt+N) does nothing without Target="nameBox". Set Target, or use TextBlock for plain text.

rules.title: Invalid TextTrimming, TextWrapping or TextAlignment value
rules.message: TextTrimming: None, CharacterEllipsis, WordEllipsis, PrefixCharacterEllipsis, LeadingCharacterEllipsis, PathSegmentEllipsis. TextWrapping: NoWrap, Wrap, WrapWithOverflow. TextAlignment: Left, Center, Right, Start, End, Justify, DetectFromContent.

rules.title: Copyable text should use SelectableTextBlock
rules.message: Text users must select and copy (error messages, IDs, values) belongs in SelectableTextBlock; TextBlock cannot be selected. Judge per screen.

rules.title: Chart ExportAsync result ignored
rules.message: ExportAsync does not throw: failures come back as ChartExportResult with Succeeded = false and raise ExportFailed. Inspect the result (or subscribe to the events).

rules.title: Chart size parameter must be finite and greater than 0
rules.message: BoxSize (Point-and-Figure), BrickSize (Renko), ReversalAmount (Kagi) and the Minimum of a LogarithmicAxis must be greater than 0.

rules.title: Icon-only button without AutomationProperties.Name
rules.message: A Button whose only content is an icon has no accessible name. Add AutomationProperties.Name (or LabeledBy).

rules.title: Button handles PointerPressed instead of Click
rules.message: Button marks PointerPressed as handled internally, so a PointerPressed handler does not fire like on other controls. Use Click, or in MVVM a Command with CommandParameter.

rules.title: RadioButtons sharing a panel form one group
rules.message: Without GroupName all RadioButtons in the same parent panel form one group. Two independent groups in one panel need distinct GroupName values.

rules.title: EnumToBoolConverter used but not registered as resource
rules.message: EnumToBoolConverter (Avalonia.Controls.Converters) must be declared as a resource with x:Key="EnumToBoolConverter" (App.axaml) before {StaticResource EnumToBoolConverter} can resolve. Each RadioButton also needs a ConverterParameter.
rules.bad: <RadioButton IsChecked="{Binding Mode, Converter={StaticResource EnumToBoolConverter}, ConverterParameter={x:Static vm:Mode.Fast}}"/>
rules.good: <Application.Resources><conv:EnumToBoolConverter x:Key="EnumToBoolConverter"/></Application.Resources><RadioButton IsChecked="{Binding Mode, Converter={StaticResource EnumToBoolConverter}, ConverterParameter={x:Static vm:Mode.Fast}}"/>

rules.title: IsThreeState on a control without a third state
rules.message: ToggleSwitch and ToggleSplitButton only know on and off. Use CheckBox for a three-state value (and a bool? binding).

rules.title: DatePicker date set from a string, or custom format without Custom
rules.message: DatePicker.SelectedDate is DateTimeOffset? and has no string conversion in AXAML: bind it to a view model property or set it in code. CalendarDatePicker.CustomDateFormatString only applies with SelectedDateFormat="Custom".

rules.title: Invalid TimePicker ClockIdentifier
rules.message: ClockIdentifier accepts only 12HourClock and 24HourClock (default is the 12-hour clock with AM/PM).

rules.title: NumericUpDown with decimal Increment but no FormatString
rules.message: With a fractional Increment set FormatString (for example 0.00 or C2); bind Value to decimal? so clearing the text box does not raise a binding error.

rules.title: Invalid Slider TickPlacement
rules.message: TickPlacement accepts None, TopLeft, BottomRight and Outside.

rules.title: Editable ComboBox is not a search box
rules.message: IsEditable only lets users type text; it neither filters nor searches the list. Use AutoCompleteBox for type-to-search (ValueMemberBinding, FilterMode).

rules.title: Invalid AutoCompleteBox FilterMode
rules.message: FilterMode is None, Custom or StartsWith, Contains, Equals with optional Ordinal and CaseSensitive (StartsWithOrdinalCaseSensitive ...). Names such as ContainsIgnoreCase do not exist.

rules.title: TextBox AcceptsTab traps keyboard focus
rules.message: AcceptsTab="True" inserts tab characters instead of moving focus, which traps keyboard users. Keep it for code editors only.

rules.title: Markdown, VirtualKeyboard or RichTextEditor without theme StyleInclude
rules.message: These Pro controls need their package and a theme StyleInclude in App.axaml (Markdown and RichTextEditor: Themes/Default.axaml, VirtualKeyboard: Themes/Fluent.axaml), otherwise the control themes are missing.

rules.title: Inline Markdown text without xml:space="preserve"
rules.message: Markdown written as element content loses line breaks and spacing to XAML whitespace normalization. Add xml:space="preserve" or bind Text="{Binding ...}".

rules.title: FlowDocument data file named .axaml or .xaml
rules.message: A file with a FlowDocument root and an .axaml/.xaml extension is fed to the XAML compiler, which cannot compile it. Name the data file .xml and load it with FlowDocument.Load(stream, new XamlSerializer()).

rules.title: RichTextEditor toolbar uses removed Items API
rules.message: EditorToolbar and ToolbarGroup no longer have Items, ItemsSource or ItemsPanel. Fill Tools instead; custom item hosts use a Panel named PART_ItemsHost.

rules.title: InsertFootnote result dereferenced without null check
rules.message: InsertFootnote returns null (it does not throw) when the position cannot take an anchor. Check the result before using it.
rules.good: var note = range.InsertFootnote(1); if (note is not null) { }

rules.title: ColorView or ColorPicker uses ShowX instead of IsXVisible
rules.message: Visibility is controlled by IsAlphaVisible, IsHexInputVisible, IsColorSpectrumVisible, IsColorPaletteVisible, IsColorPreviewVisible, IsColorComponentsVisible - there are no ShowAlpha-style properties.

rules.title: CornerRadius with three values
rules.message: CornerRadius takes one, two (top, bottom) or four values. Three values are invalid.

rules.title: Invalid BackgroundSizing value
rules.message: BackgroundSizing accepts CenterBorder, InnerBorderEdge and OuterBorderEdge.

rules.title: Invalid enum value on a layout container
rules.message: Closed value sets: ScrollBarVisibility Auto/Visible/Hidden/Disabled; SplitView.DisplayMode Overlay/Inline/CompactOverlay/CompactInline; PanePlacement Left/Right/Top/Bottom; Viewbox.Stretch None/Fill/Uniform/UniformToFill; StretchDirection UpOnly/DownOnly/Both; GridSplitter ResizeDirection Auto/Columns/Rows and ResizeBehavior BasedOnAlignment/CurrentAndNext/PreviousAndCurrent/PreviousAndNext; WrapPanel.ItemsAlignment Start/Center/End; Expander.ExpandDirection Down/Up/Left/Right; DockPanel.Dock Left/Top/Right/Bottom.

rules.title: Spacing property of another panel type
rules.message: Each panel has its own names: StackPanel Spacing; DockPanel HorizontalSpacing/VerticalSpacing; UniformGrid RowSpacing/ColumnSpacing; WrapPanel ItemSpacing/LineSpacing.

rules.title: Attached layout property written without its owner prefix
rules.message: Canvas position, DockPanel dock and Grid cell are attached properties: Canvas.Left, DockPanel.Dock, Grid.Row. A bare Left="10", Dock="Top" or Row="1" on a child is not a property of that element.

rules.title: Percent sizes in Grid definitions
rules.message: Grid sizes are absolute, Auto or star; percentages do not exist. Use star values that add up to 100 (30*, 70*).

rules.title: SharedSizeGroup without Grid.IsSharedSizeScope
rules.message: SharedSizeGroup only shares sizes between grids below a common ancestor with Grid.IsSharedSizeScope="True".

rules.title: GridSplitter removed from keyboard navigation
rules.message: GridSplitter supports arrow keys. Focusable="False" or IsTabStop="False" locks keyboard users out of resizing.

rules.title: Panel pointer handler without Background
rules.message: A Panel without Background is not hit-testable, so pointer events on empty areas are missed. Set Background="Transparent" when the whole area must react.

rules.title: RelativePanel reference to itself or non-boolean WithPanel value
rules.message: A RelativePanel property must name a sibling, not the element itself (circular reference). The Align...WithPanel properties are booleans.

rules.title: Horizontal StackPanel in ScrollViewer without horizontal scrolling
rules.message: HorizontalScrollBarVisibility defaults to Disabled, so wide content is clipped. Set HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" (and VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled" if it should scroll sideways only).

rules.title: Expander without Header
rules.message: The Expander header is the label screen readers announce for the section. Give every Expander a meaningful Header.

rules.title: Flyout property on a control that has none
rules.message: The Flyout property exists only on Button and its derivatives. Other controls use FlyoutBase.AttachedFlyout and must open it in code with FlyoutBase.ShowAttachedFlyout(control).

rules.title: SplitView pane defaults
rules.message: IsPaneOpen defaults to true, so set the start state explicitly for Overlay and Compact modes. CompactPaneLength only has an effect with CompactOverlay or CompactInline.

rules.title: PipsPager without NumberOfPages or with foreign property names
rules.message: NumberOfPages defaults to 0 (no pips). The index is SelectedPageIndex; SelectedIndex, PageCount and ItemsSource do not exist on PipsPager.

rules.title: RefreshContainer content is not scrollable
rules.message: The content of a RefreshContainer must be a ScrollViewer or contain one, otherwise the pull gesture has nothing to drive.

rules.title: LayoutTransform animated in KeyFrames
rules.message: Each LayoutTransform change triggers a full measure and arrange pass. Animate RenderTransform for smooth animations.

rules.title: TabPlacement and TabStripPlacement swapped
rules.message: TabControl uses TabStripPlacement (Top/Bottom/Left/Right); TabbedPage uses TabPlacement (Auto/Top/Bottom/Left/Right). The names are not interchangeable.

rules.title: TabItem inside TabStrip
rules.message: A TabStrip holds TabStripItem elements and shows no content. Display the content yourself from SelectedItem or SelectionChanged, or use TabControl with TabItem.

rules.title: Invalid enum value on a navigation control
rules.message: DrawerBehavior Auto/Flyout/Locked/Disabled; DrawerLayoutBehavior Overlay/Split/CompactOverlay/CompactInline; DrawerPlacement Left/Right/Top/Bottom; NavigationPage.BarLayoutBehavior Inset/Overlay; CommandBar.DefaultLabelPosition Bottom/Right/Collapsed and OverflowButtonVisibility Auto/Visible/Collapsed; TabbedPage.TabPlacement Auto/Top/Bottom/Left/Right; TabControl.TabStripPlacement Top/Bottom/Left/Right.

rules.title: TrayIcon menu built from the wrong types
rules.message: TrayIcon menus are NativeMenu with NativeMenuItem and NativeMenuItemSeparator, not Menu/ContextMenu/MenuItem/Separator. The properties are ToolTipText and IsVisible (not ToolTip/Visible).

rules.title: Non-command-bar elements in CommandBar commands
rules.message: PrimaryCommands and SecondaryCommands accept ICommandBarElement only: CommandBarButton, CommandBarToggleButton, CommandBarSeparator. Plain Button, MenuItem or Separator do not belong there.

rules.title: ContentPage with nested page or background-image property
rules.message: ContentPage.Content must not be another Page (nest pages in NavigationPage, TabbedPage, DrawerPage or CarouselPage). BackgroundImage and BackgroundImageStretch do not exist: set Background to an ImageBrush.

rules.title: Page Icon given a non-visual value without IconTemplate
rules.message: Icon accepts any object, but the default templates expect a visual such as PathIcon. A DrawingImage, Bitmap or Geometry needs a matching IconTemplate (DrawerIconTemplate).

rules.title: NavigationPage attached property set without prefix
rules.message: HasNavigationBar, HasBackButton, IsBackButtonEnabled, BackButtonContent, BarLayoutBehavior and BarHeightOverride are attached properties on the page: NavigationPage.HasNavigationBar. BarHeight belongs to the NavigationPage itself.

rules.title: Navigation task not awaited
rules.message: PushAsync, PopAsync, PopToRootAsync, ReplaceAsync, PushModalAsync and the other navigation methods return Task. Await them (or deliberately store the task).

rules.title: DrawerPage with SplitView property names or PageTransition
rules.message: DrawerPage uses DrawerLength, CompactDrawerLength, IsOpen and DrawerPlacement, not OpenPaneLength, CompactPaneLength, IsPaneOpen or PanePlacement. It has no PageTransition: set transitions on the hosted NavigationPage.

rules.title: SelectedPage is read-only
rules.message: SelectedPage of CarouselPage and TabbedPage has a getter only. Select a page with SelectedIndex.

rules.title: NativeWebView optional handle dereferenced without null check
rules.message: TryGetCommandManager, TryGetCookieManager, TryGetPlatformHandle and TryGetWebViewPlatformHandle can return null. Check the result before calling members.
rules.good: var cm = webView.TryGetCookieManager(); if (cm is not null) { }

rules.title: WebView DevTools enabled outside DEBUG
rules.message: EnableDevTools = true opens DevTools through the context menu and shortcut. Keep it out of release builds (#if DEBUG).

rules.title: WebAuthenticationBroker callback not validated
rules.message: The callback is untrusted. Compare State with the value you sent and check Error before using Code (AuthorizationCodePkceSession.ExchangeCodeAsync does this); IdToken is not validated for you.
rules.bad: var result = await WebAuthenticationBroker.AuthenticateAsync(options); var code = result.Code;
rules.good: var result = await WebAuthenticationBroker.AuthenticateAsync(options); if (result.State != expected) throw new Exception();

rules.title: Choose the right custom control category
rules.message: UserControl for app views, TemplatedControl (lookless, ControlTheme) for reusable themable widgets, Control+Render only for non-interactive graphics.

rules.title: DataContext = this in a control
rules.message: Never set DataContext = this in a control: it replaces the inherited DataContext and the consumer's bindings silently break. Use TemplateBinding or ElementName/#root instead.

rules.title: StyledProperty field naming
rules.message: Name the static field [Name]Property and register with nameof(Name); the registered name must equal the CLR property name.
rules.bad: public static readonly StyledProperty<double> Radius = AvaloniaProperty.Register<C, double>("Rad");
rules.good: public static readonly StyledProperty<double> RadiusProperty = AvaloniaProperty.Register<C, double>(nameof(Radius));

rules.title: Logic in a StyledProperty CLR setter
rules.message: The CLR wrapper must only call GetValue/SetValue. Bindings, styles and animations bypass it; react in OnPropertyChanged or Property.Changed.AddClassHandler.

rules.title: DirectProperty: SetAndRaise, never SetValue
rules.message: DirectProperty setters use SetAndRaise(Property, ref _field, value). Plain field assignment raises no change, SetValue throws.

rules.title: Re-registering an existing property
rules.message: Reuse existing properties (Background, Foreground, Padding, ...) with Border.BackgroundProperty.AddOwner<T>() instead of registering a second identity.

rules.title: OnPropertyChanged without base call first
rules.message: Call base.OnPropertyChanged(change) first, then compare change.Property.
rules.bad: protected override void OnPropertyChanged(AvaloniaPropertyChangedEventArgs change) { if (change.Property == X) { } }
rules.good: protected override void OnPropertyChanged(AvaloniaPropertyChangedEventArgs change) { base.OnPropertyChanged(change); if (change.Property == X) { } }

rules.title: Obsolete UpdateDataValidation override
rules.message: Since Avalonia 12, Register(..., enableDataValidation: true) with BindingMode.TwoWay reports errors automatically; the UpdateDataValidation override with DataValidationErrors.SetError is no longer needed.
rules.bad: protected override void UpdateDataValidation(AvaloniaProperty property, BindingValueType state, Exception? error) { }

rules.title: TemplatedControl without any ControlTheme
rules.message: Every TemplatedControl needs a ControlTheme with x:Key="{x:Type local:T}" and TargetType, and a library theme (Themes/Generic.axaml) must be included in App.axaml; without a template the control renders nothing.
rules.good:
public class ToggleLabel : TemplatedControl { }
// <ControlTheme x:Key="{x:Type local:ToggleLabel}" TargetType="local:ToggleLabel"/>

rules.title: OnApplyTemplate signature and base call
rules.message: Override OnApplyTemplate(TemplateAppliedEventArgs e), call base.OnApplyTemplate(e) first, and read parts via e.NameScope.Find/Get<T>("PART_...").
rules.good: protected override void OnApplyTemplate(TemplateAppliedEventArgs e) { base.OnApplyTemplate(e); }

rules.title: TemplateBinding limits
rules.message: TemplateBinding takes a single property (no path) and supports only OneWay/TwoWay. For paths use {Binding X.Y, RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}.

rules.title: Pseudo-class names need a leading colon
rules.message: Declare and set pseudo-classes with a leading colon: [PseudoClasses(":active")] and PseudoClasses.Set(":active", bool). Style them with ^:active inside a ControlTheme.

rules.title: Custom panel must measure and arrange every child
rules.message: MeasureOverride must call child.Measure(...) and ArrangeOverride child.Arrange(...) for every child, otherwise children render wrong or not at all.
rules.bad: class P : Panel { protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size s) => s; }
rules.good: class P : Panel { protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size s) { foreach (var c in Children) c.Measure(s); return s; } protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size f) { foreach (var c in Children) c.Arrange(new Rect(f)); return f; } }

rules.title: Attached property registered with Property suffix
rules.message: RegisterAttached takes the name without the Property suffix (field NameProperty) and needs static GetName/SetName accessors.

rules.title: RoutedEvent field naming
rules.message: Routed event fields are named [Name]Event and created with RoutedEvent.Register<TOwner, TArgs>(nameof(Name), strategy), with an AddHandler/RemoveHandler CLR wrapper.
rules.bad: public static readonly RoutedEvent<RoutedEventArgs> Changed = RoutedEvent.Register<C, RoutedEventArgs>(nameof(Changed), RoutingStrategies.Bubble);
rules.good: public static readonly RoutedEvent<RoutedEventArgs> ChangedEvent = RoutedEvent.Register<C, RoutedEventArgs>(nameof(Changed), RoutingStrategies.Bubble);

rules.title: Mutating logical children in change callbacks
rules.message: Do not add or remove logical children inside OnPropertyChanged, PropertyChanged or DataContextChanged handlers; use the constructor, OnApplyTemplate, command handlers or Loaded.
rules.bad: protected override void OnDataContextChanged(EventArgs e) { Children.Add(new Border()); }
rules.good: protected override void OnDataContextChanged(EventArgs e) { base.OnDataContextChanged(e); }

rules.title: Custom flyout must derive from PopupFlyoutBase
rules.message: Derive custom flyouts from PopupFlyoutBase and override CreatePresenter(); FlyoutBase cannot be derived directly.

rules.title: BuiltInComInteropSupport property
rules.message: BuiltInComInteropSupport was needed before Avalonia 12 (accessibility APIs) and can be removed. PublishAot belongs only in the executable project; IsAotCompatible=true in all projects and libraries.

rules.title: Reflection-based type resolution (trimming and AOT)
rules.message: With PublishTrimmed or PublishAot, Type.GetType(name), Activator.CreateInstance, ActivatorUtilities and runtime-loaded XAML are unsafe (a ViewLocator that derives a view from the ViewModel name is the classic case). Use DataTemplates or a static map; if reflection stays, protect it with TrimmerRootAssembly. Only relevant when trimming or AOT is enabled.

rules.title: PublishSingleFile without IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract
rules.message: A self-contained single-file publish needs IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true so SkiaSharp and HarfBuzz are bundled; otherwise they lie loose next to the exe.

rules.title: InvariantGlobalization enabled
rules.message: InvariantGlobalization saves about 30 MB but is only valid if the app needs no culture-specific formatting or sorting. An app with CultureInfo("de-AT"), currency ({0:C}) or date formats must not enable it.

rules.title: Event subscriptions to long-lived objects never removed
rules.message: Subscribe to events of long-lived objects (services, statics, parent windows) in Loaded or AttachedToVisualTree and unsubscribe in Unloaded or DetachedFromVisualTree (-=, RemoveHandler, Dispose). Lambda handlers cannot be removed.
rules.bad: Service.Changed += (s, e) => Refresh(); // in the constructor
rules.good: subscribe in OnAttachedToVisualTree with a named method, unsubscribe in OnDetachedFromVisualTree

rules.title: Logical tree changed inside DataContextChanged or OnPropertyChanged
rules.message: DataContext is inherited and changes travel down the logical tree. Changing Children, Content or LogicalChildren while it propagates causes binding errors. Post the change to the dispatcher or use a binding or template.

rules.title: Constructor reads DataContext or template parts too early
rules.message: In the constructor DataContext, template parts and layout are not available yet. Do initialisation that depends on them in OnLoaded (properties from XAML are ready from Initialized).
rules.bad: InitializeComponent(); if (DataContext is Vm vm) vm.Load();
rules.good: protected override void OnLoaded(RoutedEventArgs e) { base.OnLoaded(e); if (DataContext is Vm vm) vm.Load(); }

rules.title: Keyboard shortcut handled in OnKeyDown instead of KeyBinding
rules.message: Use KeyBinding or HotKey (Gesture="Ctrl+S") for shortcuts. When you do handle KeyDown yourself, set e.Handled = true.

rules.title: Pointer capture is never released
rules.message: e.Pointer.Capture(this) needs Capture(null) in OnPointerReleased, and PointerCaptureLost must reset the state.
rules.bad: protected override void OnPointerPressed(PointerPressedEventArgs e) { e.Pointer.Capture(this); }
rules.good:
protected override void OnPointerReleased(PointerReleasedEventArgs e) { e.Pointer.Capture(null); }
// e.Pointer.Capture(this) is called in OnPointerPressed

rules.title: WindowNotificationManager: one instance per window
rules.message: Create the WindowNotificationManager once per window (constructor with host TopLevel, Position, MaxItems) and keep it in a field. Creating one per call creates several hosts.
rules.good: _notifications = new WindowNotificationManager(this) { MaxItems = 3 }; // in the constructor

rules.title: ViewModel references window, storage, clipboard or notification host
rules.message: ViewModels must not reference Window, TopLevel, StorageProvider, IClipboard or WindowNotificationManager. Wrap file dialogs, clipboard, launcher and toasts in services behind interfaces (for example INotificationService, IFileDialogService) so ViewModels stay testable without UI.

rules.title: Popup without light dismiss
rules.message: Popup is a low-level building block: IsLightDismissEnabled is false by default (no close on outside click) and there is no automatic keyboard or accessibility support. Prefer Flyout, MenuFlyout, ContextMenu or ToolTip, or set IsLightDismissEnabled and handle keyboard yourself.

rules.title: ToolTip delay given as TimeSpan
rules.message: ToolTip.ShowDelay and BetweenShowDelay are integers in milliseconds, not TimeSpans.

rules.title: ToolTip on disabled controls needs ShowOnDisabled
rules.message: On a disabled control a tooltip appears only with ToolTip.ShowOnDisabled="True". Needed for 'why is this locked' hints.

rules.title: ProgressTextFormat starting with a placeholder
rules.message: A format string that starts with a placeholder needs the {} escape prefix, otherwise XAML reads it as a markup extension. Placeholders: 0 value, 1 percent, 2 minimum, 3 maximum.

rules.title: ProgressBar bound to a value without Maximum
rules.message: The default Maximum is 100. If the view model delivers 0..1 the bar looks empty: set Maximum="1" or normalize to 0..100. Check the range of the bound property.

rules.title: Program.cs without BuildAvaloniaApp
rules.message: Program needs public static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp() (exact name, used by the previewer). Do not touch Avalonia types before the app starts.
rules.bad: class Program { static void Main(string[] a) { } }
rules.good: class Program { static void Main(string[] a) { } static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp() => null; }

rules.title: Hard cast of ApplicationLifetime
rules.message: ApplicationLifetime is null in design mode. Check with 'is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime desktop' instead of casting.

rules.title: OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted without base call
rules.message: Call base.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted() at the end of the override.

rules.title: OnPlatform with only named non-Windows values
rules.message: Without a matching platform and without Default (or a first positional default) the property gets its type default. Add Windows= or Default=.

rules.title: OnExplicitShutdown without Shutdown call
rules.message: With ShutdownMode.OnExplicitShutdown the process ends only through Shutdown(); otherwise it hangs.

rules.title: Static access to MainWindow
rules.message: Global MainWindow access risks dialogs on the wrong window and breaks MVVM. Take the nearest TopLevel (TopLevel.GetTopLevel(control)) or an injected service.

rules.title: GetTopLevel result dereferenced without null check
rules.message: TopLevel.GetTopLevel(visual) is null until the control is attached (for example in the constructor). Use ?. and call after Loaded.

rules.title: Overlay/Adorner layer used without null check
rules.message: OverlayLayer.GetOverlayLayer and AdornerLayer.GetAdornerLayer can return null. Check before use and remove added children later.

rules.title: Code-behind without InitializeComponent
rules.message: A Window/UserControl code-behind must call InitializeComponent() or the UI is never loaded.
rules.bad: public partial class MainWindow : Window { public MainWindow() { } }
rules.good: public partial class MainWindow : Window { public MainWindow() { InitializeComponent(); } }

rules.title: Code-behind class is not partial
rules.message: The code-behind of a XAML view must be a partial class with the same name as x:Class.

rules.title: FindControl for a named control
rules.message: Controls with x:Name get a generated field in the partial class; FindControl<T>("Name") is redundant for own names (names inside templates are not generated).

rules.title: clr-namespace instead of using:
rules.message: Prefer xmlns:alias="using:Namespace"; clr-namespace without ;assembly= only resolves in the own assembly.

rules.title: ViewModel depends on Avalonia UI types
rules.message: ViewModels should be POCOs without references to Avalonia or the view so they stay testable. Inject services (IDialogService) instead.

rules.title: Only StyledProperty is stylable
rules.message: Setters, animations and inheritance work only for StyledProperty. DirectProperty and CLR properties cannot be styled.

rules.title: Assets not included as AvaloniaResource
rules.message: Assets are included with <AvaloniaResource Include="Assets\**"/>, not Content/EmbeddedResource/None.

rules.title: String-path code bindings
rules.message: new Binding("Path") uses reflection and is not checked at build time. Prefer CompiledBinding.Create(vm => vm.X).

rules.title: Compiled bindings as project default
rules.message: Set <AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault>true</AvaloniaUseCompiledBindingsByDefault> (csproj or Directory.Build.props) and x:DataType so bindings are checked at build time.

rules.title: All Avalonia packages on one version, one base theme
rules.message: Avalonia, Avalonia.Desktop, Avalonia.Themes.Fluent and extra packages (DataGrid, Fonts.Inter) should share one version (central Directory.Packages.props); use exactly one base theme in Application.Styles.

rules.title: Fast DispatcherTimer for animation
rules.message: Frame-synchronous animation should use TopLevel.RequestAnimationFrame (re-schedule in the callback), not a ~16 ms DispatcherTimer plus InvalidateVisual.
rules.bad: var t = new DispatcherTimer { Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(16) };

rules.title: Gradient points without percent are absolute pixels
rules.message: StartPoint, EndPoint, Center and GradientOrigin are relative to the fill only with a percent sign; plain numbers are absolute pixels, so WPF-style 0,0 / 1,1 gives a 1 px gradient. Write 0%,0% / 100%,100%.

rules.title: OpacityMask uses only the alpha channel
rules.message: Only the alpha channel of an OpacityMask matters. A mask whose stops are all fully opaque changes nothing; fade out with a Transparent stop.

rules.title: Pen, brush, text or bitmap created inside Render()
rules.message: Render runs on the UI thread for every redraw. Keep Pen, Brush, FormattedText, Typeface, geometries and Bitmap in (static) fields and rebuild them only when their inputs change. Values that change every frame (animation) are the exception.

rules.title: StyledProperty used by Render without AffectsRender
rules.message: The result of Render is cached. A custom control that registers properties and overrides Render needs AffectsRender<T>(Property) in its static constructor (or InvalidateVisual()), otherwise the display goes stale. Ignore if none of the properties feeds into Render.

rules.title: Drawing with Bounds instead of local coordinates
rules.message: Inside Render the coordinate system starts at (0,0), but Bounds is relative to the parent (X/Y are usually not 0). Draw with new Rect(Bounds.Size) or Bounds.Width/Height.

rules.title: Push* drawing state without using
rules.message: PushClip, PushGeometryClip, PushOpacity, PushOpacityMask, PushTransform and PushRenderOptions return IDisposable; the state is reset only by Dispose. Wrap the call in using.

rules.title: FormattedText for multi-line text
rules.message: FormattedText is meant for short single-line text. Wrapping, justification and line metrics need TextLayout (MaxWidth, TextAlignment, TextLines).
rules.bad: new FormattedText(paragraph, culture, dir, face, 12, brush) { MaxTextWidth = 200 }

rules.title: SKPaint or SKPath without using
rules.message: SKPaint, SKPath and the Skia API lease are IDisposable (the documentation sample leaks the path). Declare them with using; also check that the Avalonia.Skia and SkiaSharp versions match Avalonia 12.1 in Directory.Packages.props.

rules.title: CompositionCustomVisualHandler must not read UI state
rules.message: The handler runs on the render thread. It must not read controls, view models or properties; send data with SendHandlerMessage and store it in OnMessage. For simple UI-thread loops TopLevel.RequestAnimationFrame is enough.

rules.title: Self-drawn control is hit-testable only on drawn pixels
rules.message: A control that only draws shapes reacts to the pointer only on those pixels. For the whole area draw context.DrawRectangle(Brushes.Transparent, null, new Rect(Bounds.Size)) first or implement ICustomHitTest.
rules.bad: Render draws only a ring; clicks into the hole are lost

rules.title: Pointer handler on a panel or border without Background
rules.message: Elements with Classes= are skipped (a style may set the background). Without a Background the empty area of a panel or border is not hit-testable, so the handler only fires over children. Set Background="Transparent" (the same applies to ContextMenu/ContextFlyout hosts; shapes need a Fill).

rules.title: Decorative overlays block input
rules.message: Overlays, watermarks and status text above interactive content need IsHitTestVisible="False"; blocking loading overlays tie IsHitTestVisible to their visibility. Transparent elements take part in hit testing, so only give Background="Transparent" to areas that need clicks.

rules.title: Hundreds of hit-testable elements on one canvas
rules.message: Avalonia hit-tests every element without a spatial index. With hundreds or thousands of children on a Canvas or Panel, pointer events lag; use one catch-all layer with its own lookup, a control that draws everything in Render, or fewer hit-testable elements.
rules.good: one Background="Transparent" layer with custom hit logic

rules.title: Rounded Border around Image without ClipToBounds
rules.message: A Border with CornerRadius clips its child to the rounded shape only with ClipToBounds="True" (the documentation text claims automatic clipping, its examples set it). Add ClipToBounds for avatars and pictures.

rules.title: BoxShadow on a control other than Border or ContentPresenter
rules.message: The BoxShadow property exists only on Border and ContentPresenter. Wrap the control in a Border or use a Setter on its /template/ ContentPresenter. Elements with an XML namespace prefix (custom controls) are not checked.

rules.title: BoxShadow with negative blur
rules.message: BoxShadow syntax is [inset] offsetX offsetY blur spread color. blur must not be negative; only spread may be negative.

rules.title: DropShadowEffect on a Border instead of BoxShadow
rules.message: BoxShadow is cheaper for rectangular shadows. Reserve DropShadowEffect and BlurEffect for text, images and arbitrary shapes.

rules.title: Opacity=0 used to hide an element
rules.message: An element with Opacity=0 stays in layout, focus order and hit testing, and its keyframe animations keep running. Hide with IsVisible="False" (add IsHitTestVisible="False" if it must keep its space). Style setters that fade an element in and out are not checked.

rules.title: Downscaled raster icon without HighQuality interpolation
rules.message: The default interpolation is LowQuality. Strongly scaled-down raster images look better with RenderOptions.BitmapInterpolationMode="HighQuality"; prefer vector (PathIcon or DrawingImage). Pixel art keeps None.

rules.title: RenderOptions.EdgeMode=Aliased
rules.message: EdgeMode=Aliased switches off antialiasing for shapes and borders too, and on a container for all children. Use it only for pixel art or deliberately sharp edges, on the affected element.

rules.title: TextRenderingMode=Alias
rules.message: TextRenderingMode=Alias gives jagged text and is not meant for normal UI text (default Auto). Text that is scrolled or animated by RenderTransform also needs TextOptions.BaselinePixelAlignment="Unaligned".

rules.title: Invalid Image.BlendMode value
rules.message: Image.BlendMode takes BitmapBlendingMode values only (SourceOver, Multiply, Screen, ...); there is no Normal or Unspecified in 12.1. Support depends on the backend (Skia supports all).

rules.title: RenderTransformOrigin needs percentages
rules.message: RenderTransformOrigin is a RelativePoint: write 50%,50%. WPF values like 0.5,0.5 are absolute pixels in Avalonia, so the pivot ends up near the top left. The default is already the center.

rules.title: Transform shorthand without unit
rules.message: In the RenderTransform shorthand the documentation uses px for translate and deg/grad/rad/turn for angles; unitless numbers other than 0 are not documented. Write rotate(45deg), translate(10px, 0px).

rules.title: RenderTransform does not change layout
rules.message: A RenderTransform leaves layout untouched, so rotated text (+-90 degrees) overlaps its neighbours; use LayoutTransformControl for that and do not animate a LayoutTransform (every frame triggers layout). Animated effects belong on RenderTransform.

rules.title: StreamGeometry context without using
rules.message: geometry.Open() returns a context that must be closed with using; every BeginFigure needs an EndFigure. Define static icon paths once as StreamGeometry resources.

rules.title: Ancestor binding to DataContext without a cast
rules.message: With compiled bindings $parent[X].DataContext is typed object. Cast: $parent[ListBox].((vm:MainViewModel)DataContext).Cmd.

rules.title: Make binding errors visible
rules.message: Add .LogToTrace(LogEventLevel.Warning) in BuildAvaloniaApp so binding errors appear in the trace.

rules.title: Bound collections: ObservableCollection and bulk changes
rules.message: Runtime-changing ItemsSource collections must be ObservableCollection<T>. For large batches replace the collection instead of thousands of Add calls.

rules.title: ItemsControl and ItemsPanel do not virtualize
rules.message: ItemsControl and StackPanel/WrapPanel item panels do not virtualize. For large lists use ListBox or a VirtualizingStackPanel.

rules.title: HierarchicalDataTemplate does not exist
rules.message: Avalonia's hierarchical template is TreeDataTemplate; HierarchicalDataTemplate is WPF.

rules.title: Template-part selector without /template/
rules.message: Selectors for template parts (#PART_...) need /template/ so they search the control template, not the logical tree.

rules.title: ComboBox: ItemsSource, SelectedValue, text entry
rules.message: Bind ItemsSource plus SelectedItem (or SelectedValueBinding/SelectedValue). IsEditable has no search-as-you-type; use AutoCompleteBox. Static ComboBoxItem children with a SelectedItem bound to another type do not work.

rules.title: DataGrid without the DataGrid package
rules.message: DataGrid ships in the Avalonia.Controls.DataGrid package (same version as Avalonia) plus its theme StyleInclude in App.axaml.

rules.title: Blocking on ShowDialog
rules.message: Await modal dialogs (await dialog.ShowDialog<T>(owner)); .Result/.Wait()/GetResult() blocks the UI thread.

rules.title: Writing user data next to the executable
rules.message: Store settings under Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData plus an app folder, never in the install directory.

rules.title: Clipboard access
rules.message: Get the clipboard from TopLevel.GetTopLevel(this)?.Clipboard (not Application.Current), and dispose the object returned by TryGetDataAsync (using var).

rules.title: Image Source without avares:// or rooted path
rules.message: Embedded images use avares://Assembly/Assets/... (or a rooted /Assets/...) plus <AvaloniaResource Include="Assets\**"/>. An invalid URI gives a zero-size Image.

rules.title: Embedded font URI without #family
rules.message: Embedded font references need the internal family name after '#' (avares://Asm/Assets/Fonts#Name or fonts:Collection#Name). Without it Avalonia silently falls back to the default font.

rules.title: OnFormFactor does not react to window size
rules.message: OnFormFactor is evaluated once at startup and is meaningless in a desktop-only app. For live size changes use Container.Name/Container.Sizing with ContainerQuery.

rules.title: ShowGridLines left in
rules.message: ShowGridLines="True" is a development aid; remove it before shipping.

rules.title: Task.Delay().ContinueWith touches UI state off-thread
rules.message: ContinueWith runs on a thread-pool thread. Marshal UI-bound changes with Dispatcher.UIThread.Post, or use await.

rules.title: Slider with TickFrequency but no snapping
rules.message: TickFrequency only draws ticks. For stepped values add IsSnapToTickEnabled="True".

rules.title: ViewLocator based on reflection
rules.message: A ViewLocator using Type.GetType/Activator.CreateInstance is fragile under trimming and AOT. Prefer explicit DataTemplates per view model or a factory dictionary.

rules.title: InputGesture without a real key binding
rules.message: MenuItem.InputGesture only displays text. Add a KeyBinding (Window.KeyBindings) or HotKey so the shortcut works.

rules.title: Access key is not a hotkey
rules.message: A leading underscore in Content/Header only defines an Alt access key. A global shortcut needs HotKey or KeyBinding.

rules.title: Digit in gesture string
rules.message: The docs use both Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+D1 for digit keys. Pick one spelling (D0-D9 / NumPad0-9 are the documented key names) and test it.

rules.title: There is no MouseBinding
rules.message: Avalonia has no MouseBinding or MouseGesture. Use DoubleTapped (forward to the view model) or ContextMenu/ContextFlyout.

rules.title: KeyBinding only works inside its focus scope
rules.message: A KeyBinding on a control fires only while that control or a child has focus. App-wide shortcuts belong on Window.KeyBindings or HotKey.

rules.title: Application logic in Click handlers
rules.message: Events are for control-specific UI actions (drag, size). Business actions (save, delete, navigate) belong in a [RelayCommand] bound with Command=.

rules.title: CanExecute without change notification
rules.message: [RelayCommand(CanExecute = ...)] re-evaluates only when a property it reads has [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] or NotifyCanExecuteChanged() is called. Skip when CanX reads only constants.

rules.title: Async command as async void
rules.message: A [RelayCommand] async method must return Task. async void loses IsRunning, cancellation and the double-start guard.

rules.title: Hand-written ICommand or ReactiveUI in a toolkit project
rules.message: Prefer one command mechanism. The docs use CommunityToolkit.Mvvm ([RelayCommand]); hand-written ICommand classes and ReactiveUI snippets should not be mixed in.

rules.title: Synchronous DoDragDrop
rules.message: DragDrop.DoDragDrop does not exist in Avalonia 12. Use await DragDrop.DoDragDropAsync(pointerPressedArgs, dataTransfer, effects).

rules.title: Drop target without AllowDrop
rules.message: A drop target needs DragDrop.AllowDrop="True"; DragOver handlers must set e.DragEffects.

rules.title: Disposing the DataTransfer given to a drag
rules.message: Avalonia disposes the DataTransfer passed to DoDragDropAsync. Do not wrap it in using or call Dispose.
rules.bad:
using var data = new DataTransfer();
await DragDrop.DoDragDropAsync(e, data, DragDropEffects.Move);
rules.good:
var data = new DataTransfer();
await DragDrop.DoDragDropAsync(e, data, DragDropEffects.Move);

rules.title: Start the drag only after a minimum distance
rules.message: Do not call DoDragDropAsync directly in PointerPressed. Store the pressed args and start in PointerMoved after a threshold.
rules.good: _pressed = e; // start in OnPointerMoved after threshold

rules.title: Reset drag highlight in DragLeave and Drop
rules.message: DragLeave does not fire after Drop. Whoever highlights in DragEnter must reset in both DragLeave and Drop (or use a pseudo-class).

rules.title: Holding without IsHoldingEnabled
rules.message: The Holding event fires only with InputElement.IsHoldingEnabled="True" (mouse additionally needs IsHoldWithMouseEnabled).

rules.title: Typed text via TextInput, not KeyDown
rules.message: Read typed characters from TextInputEvent (e.Text). KeyDown misses IME text and dead keys; use it only for shortcuts, arrows, Enter, Escape.

rules.title: Use Handled and routing deliberately
rules.message: Handled=true suppresses later handlers. A parent handler does not see events the child already handled unless it uses Tunnel or handledEventsToo.
rules.bad: Window KeyDown="OnEnter" expects Enter from a TextBox

rules.title: Custom text controls need an IME client
rules.message: A hand-built text input control must implement ITextInputMethodClient and register it with TextInputMethod.SetClient on focus.
rules.bad: Control handles OnTextInput without IME client

rules.title: Grid without definitions
rules.message: A Grid without rows/columns behaves like a Panel but costs more. Use Panel for layering and StackPanel/UniformGrid for simple cases.

rules.title: Canvas in a normal UI
rules.message: Canvas does not adapt to window size. Use it for drawing surfaces, charts and drag positioning, not for ordinary forms.

rules.title: Nesting depth of layout panels
rules.message: More than three nested layout panels usually collapse into one Grid with proper definitions.
rules.good: one Grid with rows and columns

rules.title: Stretch combined with a fixed size
rules.message: An explicit Width/Height wins over Stretch; the combination is contradictory.

rules.title: Padding or Panel.ZIndex on panels
rules.message: Panels (StackPanel, Grid, DockPanel, ...) have no Padding; use a Border or Margin on children. ZIndex is a property of the child (ZIndex="1"), there is no Panel.ZIndex.

rules.title: Opacity=0 used to hide
rules.message: IsVisible="False" removes a control from layout and rendering; Opacity="0" keeps space and render cost. Use Opacity only when the space must stay or for animations.

rules.title: Repeated Margin instead of Spacing
rules.message: Equal gaps between siblings come from StackPanel.Spacing (Grid.RowSpacing/ColumnSpacing), not repeated Margin on each child.

rules.title: DockPanel order and fill
rules.message: The last child fills the rest; docked children must precede it, and DockPanel.Dock on the last child has no effect (unless LastChildFill=False).
rules.good: docked children first, fill child last

rules.title: Size-dependent layout via ContainerQuery
rules.message: Pure size-based switching (columns, visibility) belongs in ContainerQuery, not in OnSizeChanged plus view-model flags.

rules.title: Overlapping container-query breakpoints
rules.message: max-width:400 and min-width:400 both match at exactly 400. Close ranges with 'and' or order from small to large deliberately.

rules.title: Choose the simplest fitting panel
rules.message: Equal cells: UniformGrid; flowing items: WrapPanel; layering: Panel; edges: DockPanel. RelativePanel only when Grid/StackPanel are not enough.

rules.title: Icon path with a hard-coded fill
rules.message: Scalable icons belong in a PathIcon with a StreamGeometry resource; its color comes from the inherited Foreground. A Path with a fixed Fill ignores theme and state. Multi-color illustrations are fine.

rules.title: Inline path data repeated in views
rules.message: Store each geometry once as a StreamGeometry with x:Key and reference it with StaticResource; do not repeat long Data strings in views.
rules.bad: the same 300-character Data in four views

rules.title: Image source without avares:// URI
rules.message: The documented pattern for assets is avares://<Assembly>/Assets/...; relative paths appear only in partial examples. Use avares:// consistently.

rules.title: Tiled brush without DestinationRect
rules.message: Tiling needs a TileMode other than None and a DestinationRect that sets the tile size.

rules.title: MediaPlayer source must not be set in the constructor
rules.message: Set MediaPlayerControl.Source only after Loaded (OnLoaded or Dispatcher.UIThread.Post); in the constructor it fails silently. Bindings are safe. Avalonia Pro package.
rules.bad: public MainWindow() { InitializeComponent(); player.Source = new UriSource(uri); }
rules.good: protected override void OnLoaded(RoutedEventArgs e) { base.OnLoaded(e); player.Source = new UriSource(uri); }

rules.title: UriSource with a local path instead of file://
rules.message: UriSource needs a URI: local files use the file:// scheme. Streams passed to StreamSource belong to the player afterwards and must not be disposed with using. Avalonia Pro package.

rules.title: MenuItem.InputGesture only displays the shortcut
rules.message: InputGesture shows the shortcut text but does not bind it. The actual shortcut needs its own KeyBinding or HotKey with the same gesture.

rules.title: MenuItem with Click handler instead of Command
rules.message: Menu items trigger through Command (keyboard and click) so CanExecute controls the state; a code-behind Click handler bypasses the MVVM pattern.

rules.title: Radio MenuItem without GroupName
rules.message: Radio menu items need a common GroupName; bind IsChecked.
