rules.title: ContextMenu and ContextFlyout on the same element
rules.message: A control has either a ContextMenu or a ContextFlyout, not both; only one is used.

rules.title: ContextMenu command parameter is the list selection
rules.message: SelectedItem is the selection, not necessarily the row that was right-clicked. For row menus put the ContextMenu in the item template with CommandParameter="{Binding}" or make sure the row is selected before the menu opens.

rules.title: ControlTheme for MenuItem without BasedOn
rules.message: A custom ControlTheme for ItemContainerTheme sets BasedOn="{StaticResource {x:Type MenuItem}}", otherwise the default look is lost. Ignore for fully restyled themes.

rules.title: NativeMenu shows no menu bar on Windows
rules.message: NativeMenu.Menu renders on macOS and some Linux desktops, not as a menu bar on Windows; keep a Menu in the window for Windows. NativeDock.Menu works only on macOS. TrayIcon.Menu works on Windows.

rules.title: NativeMenuItem without Click or Command stays disabled
rules.message: A NativeMenuItem without Click or Command is disabled. Separators use <NativeMenuItemSeparator/>. Gesture is Modifier+...+Key with Alt, Control, Shift, Meta; a bad format throws ArgumentException.

rules.title: TargetFramework must be .NET 8 or newer
rules.message: Avalonia 12 supports only .NET 8 and newer; .NET Framework, .NET Standard and older .NET are gone. Use `net10.0` (or `net10.0-windows`).

rules.title: All Avalonia packages on one 12.x version
rules.message: Avalonia 12 needs every core Avalonia package on the same 12.x patch version. Update the version (central `Directory.Packages.props` or `AvaloniaVersion`).

rules.title: Avalonia.Diagnostics and AttachDevTools are removed
rules.message: The `Avalonia.Diagnostics` package and `AttachDevTools()` no longer exist. Use `AvaloniaUI.DiagnosticsSupport` with `AttachDeveloperTools()` (Avalonia Plus) or remove the call.

rules.title: Direct2D1 backend is removed, use Skia
rules.message: `Avalonia.Direct2D1` and `UseDirect2D1()` are gone; rendering runs on Skia. Use `UseSkia()` or `UsePlatformDetect()`.

rules.title: UseSkia() without UseHarfBuzz() fails at startup
rules.message: With an explicit `UseSkia()` the text shaper must be configured too: add the `Avalonia.HarfBuzz` package and `.UseHarfBuzz()`, or use `UsePlatformDetect()`. Otherwise startup throws 'No text shaping system configured'.

rules.title: IBinding and InstancedBinding are removed
rules.message: `IBinding` is now `BindingBase`, `InstancedBinding` is now `BindingExpressionBase`. Create bindings with `CompiledBinding.Create(x => x.Prop)` or `ReflectionBinding`.

rules.title: Binding plugins are no longer public
rules.message: `BindingPlugins`, `IDataValidationPlugin` and related types are internal in 12. Delete the `BindingPlugins.DataValidators.RemoveAt(0)` / `DisableAvaloniaDataAnnotationValidation` workaround; data annotation validation is off by default.
rules.good: // nothing to do: data annotation validation is off by default

rules.title: DataObject, DataFormats and the old clipboard API are removed
rules.message: `IDataObject`, `DataObject`, `DataFormats`, `GetTextAsync`, `GetDataAsync`, `GetFormatsAsync` and `SetDataObjectAsync` are removed or compile errors. Use `DataTransfer`/`DataTransferItem` with `DataFormat.Text`, `SetDataAsync`, `TryGetTextAsync`, `TryGetDataAsync`.

rules.title: DragDrop.DoDragDrop and DragEventArgs.Data are removed
rules.message: `DragDrop.DoDragDrop` is now `await DragDrop.DoDragDropAsync(...)`, and `DragEventArgs.Data` is replaced by `DragEventArgs.DataTransfer`.

rules.title: Clipboard and drag-drop no longer serialize arbitrary objects
rules.message: Avalonia 12 dropped `BinaryFormatter`. Custom objects put on the clipboard or in drag-and-drop must be serialized explicitly (for example with System.Text.Json).

rules.title: Removed root interfaces (IRenderRoot, ILayoutRoot, ...)
rules.message: `TopLevel` is no longer the root of the visual tree and `IRenderRoot`, `ILayoutRoot`, `ITextInputMethodRoot`, `IEmbeddedLayoutRoot` and `LayoutManager` are gone or internal. Use `TopLevel.GetTopLevel(visual)` and `ILayoutManager`.

rules.title: Window.SystemDecorations is obsolete
rules.message: `Window.SystemDecorations` is obsolete in 12 (the build turns the warning into an error when warnings are errors). Use `WindowDecorations`.

rules.title: ExtendClientAreaChromeHints and Chrome title bar types are removed
rules.message: `ExtendClientAreaChromeHints`, `ChromeOverlayLayer` and `Chrome:TitleBar`/`Chrome:CaptionButtons` are removed. Use `WindowDecorations` with `ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint`, and `WindowDrawnDecorations` for drawn chrome.

rules.title: Old ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint workarounds can go
rules.message: On Windows `ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint` now works in all cases. Remove old margin/padding workarounds for the maximized state (for example code that sets a `Margin` when `WindowState == Maximized`).

rules.title: WindowState cannot be set from a Style
rules.message: `Window.WindowState` is a `DirectProperty` in 12 and cannot be set by a `Setter`. Set it on the window element or in code.

rules.title: GotFocusEventArgs and KeyboardNavigationHandler are removed
rules.message: `GotFocusEventArgs` is gone (`GotFocus`/`LostFocus` use `FocusChangedEventArgs`) and `KeyboardNavigationHandler` is internal. Use `FocusManager` and `FocusManager.GetNextElement`.
rules.bad: private void OnGotFocus(object? sender, GotFocusEventArgs e) { }
rules.good: private void OnGotFocus(object? sender, FocusChangedEventArgs e) { }

rules.title: Gesture events live on InputElement, no Gestures. prefix
rules.message: The `Gestures` class is no longer public. Use the events directly: `Pinch="..."` in XAML, `InputElement.PinchEvent` in C#.

rules.title: Screen.Primary and Screen.PixelDensity are removed
rules.message: `Screen` is abstract: never construct it. `Screen.Primary` is now `Screen.IsPrimary`, `Screen.PixelDensity` is now `Screen.Scaling`. Get screens from `TopLevel.Screens`.

rules.title: OpenFileDialog/SaveFileDialog/OpenFolderDialog are removed
rules.message: The dialog classes are gone. Use `TopLevel.GetTopLevel(this)!.StorageProvider` with `OpenFilePickerAsync`, `SaveFilePickerAsync`, `OpenFolderPickerAsync`.

rules.title: ToggleButton Checked/Unchecked/Indeterminate events are removed
rules.message: Only `IsCheckedChanged` exists on `ToggleButton`, `CheckBox`, `RadioButton` and `ToggleSwitch`. Bind `IsChecked` or handle `IsCheckedChanged`.

rules.title: PlacementMode property is removed (use Placement)
rules.message: `Popup.PlacementMode` and `ContextMenu.PlacementMode` are removed; the property is `Placement` (type `PlacementMode`).

rules.title: Obsolete item container APIs are removed
rules.message: Use `ItemsControl.ContainerFromIndex/IndexFromContainer` instead of `ItemContainerGenerator`, `ItemsControlFromItemContainer` (typo fixed), and `TreeView` instead of `TreeContainerIndex`.

rules.title: Other removed legacy members (binding, graphics, lifetime)
rules.message: These members are removed: `BindingPriority.TemplatedParent` (use `Template`), `Color.ToUint32` (`ToUInt32`), `CubicBezierEasing` (`SplineEasing`), `CustomAnimatorBase` (`InterpolatingAnimator<T>`), `IStyleable` (`StyledElement`), `RadialGradientBrush.Radius` (`RadiusX`/`RadiusY`), `LifetimeOverride`, `IActivatableApplicationLifetime`/`IApplicationPlatformEvents` (`TryGetFeature<IActivatableLifetime>()`), `DisplayEdgeToEdge` (`DisplayEdgeToEdgePreference`).

rules.title: TextBox Watermark is now PlaceholderText
rules.message: `Watermark` and `UseFloatingWatermark` are obsolete on `TextBox`, `NumericUpDown`, `AutoCompleteBox` and `MaskedTextBox`. Use `PlaceholderText` and `UseFloatingPlaceholder`.

rules.title: RenderOptions.TextRenderingMode moved to TextOptions
rules.message: `RenderOptions.TextRenderingMode` is obsolete. Use `TextOptions.TextRenderingMode` (also `TextHintingMode`, `BaselinePixelAlignment`).

rules.title: Renamed or removed types (typo fixes, native menu, geometry)
rules.message: Renamed or removed in 12: `NativeMenuItemToggleType` is `MenuItemToggleType`, `IGeometryContext2` is `IGeometryContext`, `PseudolassesExtensions` is `PseudoClassesExtensions`, `ExterinalGLibMainLoopExceptionLogger` is `ExternalGLibMainLoopExceptionLogger`; `NativeMenuBar.EnableMenuItemClickForwarding` has no effect.

rules.title: Popup host internals are no longer public
rules.message: `IPopupHost`, `IPopupHostProvider` and `LightDismissOverlayLayer` are internal in 12. Build custom popups on `Popup` and `OverlayLayer.GetOverlayLayer`.
rules.good: var popup = new Popup { Placement = PlacementMode.Bottom };

rules.title: SelectingItemsControl.UpdateSelectionFromEventSource is obsolete
rules.message: Override `UpdateSelectionFromEvent` (and `ShouldTriggerSelection`) instead of `UpdateSelectionFromEventSource`; containers now handle selection themselves.
rules.bad: protected override void UpdateSelectionFromEventSource(object? source, bool select) { }
rules.good: protected override void UpdateSelectionFromEvent(Control source, RoutedEventArgs e) { }

rules.title: UpdateDataValidation override that only calls SetError
rules.message: Properties registered with `enableDataValidation: true` now report validation errors automatically. An `UpdateDataValidation` override that only calls `DataValidationErrors.SetError` can be deleted.

rules.title: Access keys are triggered by symbol; AccessText.AccessKey is string?
rules.message: Access keys (`_File`) now match the typed symbol, including digits and accented letters, and `AccessText.AccessKey` changed from `char` to `string?`. Fix code that reads it and check for duplicate access keys.

rules.title: Animations stop on invisible controls
rules.message: Style-driven animations no longer run on hidden controls. Where state must keep advancing (a clock or progress in a hidden panel), set `Animation.PlaybackBehavior="Always"`.

rules.title: DispatcherTimer and SynchronizationContext follow the creating thread
rules.message: `DispatcherTimer` and `AvaloniaSynchronizationContext` use the dispatcher of the thread that creates them. Create them on the UI thread or pass `Dispatcher.UIThread`; `Dispatcher.InvokeAsync` now captures the `ExecutionContext`.

rules.title: Headless test packages need xUnit v3 / NUnit 4
rules.message: `Avalonia.Headless.XUnit` targets xUnit.net 3 and `Avalonia.Headless.NUnit` targets NUnit 4. Move the test packages (`xunit.v3`, NUnit 4) accordingly.

rules.title: Only .ttf and .otf fonts are supported
rules.message: Avalonia 12 has its own font parser and supports only TrueType (.ttf) and OpenType (.otf). Type 1 fonts (.pfb, .pfm) no longer load; convert them.

rules.title: Removed render-target and Skia GPU interfaces
rules.message: `IRenderTarget2`, `IRenderTargetWithProperties`, `IGlPlatformSurfaceRenderTarget2`, `ISkiaGpuRenderTarget2` and `ISkiaGpuWithPlatformGraphicsContext` were merged into their base types. Only custom rendering backends are affected.

rules.title: ResourcesChangedEventArgs is a struct without Empty
rules.message: `ResourcesChangedEventArgs` is a `struct` in 12 and `Empty` is removed; use `ResourcesChangedEventArgs.Create`.

rules.title: ControlTheme belongs in Resources, not in Styles
rules.message: A `ControlTheme` is a resource found by type (`x:Key="{x:Type Button}"`, `TargetType="Button"`). Put it in `Resources`, not directly in `Styles`.

rules.title: SetValue on a DirectProperty throws; use SetAndRaise
rules.message: For a `DirectProperty` (registered with `RegisterDirect`) the CLR setter must call `SetAndRaise(Prop, ref _field, value)`; `SetValue` throws. A `StyledProperty` has no backing field and uses `GetValue`/`SetValue` only.

rules.title: WPF dependency property types do not exist in Avalonia
rules.message: `DependencyProperty`, `DependencyObject`, `PropertyMetadata`, `FrameworkElement` and `UIElement` do not exist. Use `AvaloniaProperty.Register<TOwner, T>(..., defaultValue:)` with `OnPropertyChanged` or `XProperty.Changed.AddClassHandler`; base controls on `Control` (drawn) or `TemplatedControl` (templated).
rules.bad: public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(int), typeof(Gauge));
rules.good: public static readonly StyledProperty<int> ValueProperty = AvaloniaProperty.Register<Gauge, int>(nameof(Value));

rules.title: WPF routed event APIs do not exist
rules.message: `EventManager`, `RoutedEventHandler` and `Preview*` events do not exist. Use `RoutedEvent.Register<TOwner, TArgs>`, `EventHandler<TArgs>` and `AddHandler(InputElement.KeyDownEvent, handler, RoutingStrategies.Tunnel)`.

rules.title: WPF mouse events are Pointer events in Avalonia
rules.message: Use `PointerPressed`/`PointerReleased`/`PointerMoved`/`PointerEntered`/`PointerExited`/`PointerWheelChanged`; check the button via `e.GetCurrentPoint(this).Properties`.

rules.title: WPF triggers and implicit TargetType styles do not exist
rules.message: Avalonia styles are selector based: `<Style Selector="Button:pointerover">`. There are no `Style.Triggers`, `Trigger`/`DataTrigger`/`EventTrigger`, `VisualStateManager` or `<Style TargetType=...>` without `Selector`.

rules.title: Invalid pseudo-class names in selectors
rules.message: Avalonia pseudo-classes are `:pointerover`, `:pressed`, `:disabled`, `:checked`, `:focus`, `:selected`, `:expanded`. `:hover`, `:mouseover`, `:focused` and `:enabled` never match.

rules.title: DataTrigger replacement: class binding, converter or container query
rules.message: Drive ViewModel state with `Classes.error="{Binding HasError}"` plus a style selector. For size-dependent layout use `Container.Name`/`Container.Sizing` and `ContainerQuery` instead of binding `Bounds.Width` through a converter.

rules.title: HierarchicalDataTemplate is TreeDataTemplate
rules.message: `HierarchicalDataTemplate` does not exist; use `TreeDataTemplate` and put templates in `DataTemplates`.

rules.title: DataTemplate without key stored in Resources
rules.message: Type-matched templates (`DataType="..."`) belong in `X.DataTemplates` (control or `Application.DataTemplates`), not in `Resources`, where they are not matched by type.

rules.title: Template order: specific DataType before general
rules.message: Avalonia matches `DataType` against base classes and interfaces and evaluates templates in declaration order. Put templates for derived types before those for their base types.

rules.title: DataTemplateSelector does not exist
rules.message: Implement `IDataTemplate` (`Build` and `Match`) or use `FuncDataTemplate`, or rely on `DataType` matching, instead of `DataTemplateSelector`.

rules.title: ListView/GridView do not exist; Items is read-only
rules.message: Use `ListBox` (with `ItemTemplate`/`ItemsPanel`) instead of `ListView`/`GridView`, and bind `ItemsSource`, not `Items`.

rules.title: Visibility does not exist; use IsVisible
rules.message: Use `IsVisible="{Binding Show}"` (bool) instead of `Visibility` and visibility converters. For WPF `Hidden` use `Opacity="0"`.

rules.title: ToolTip is the attached property ToolTip.Tip
rules.message: Set tooltips with `ToolTip.Tip="..."`, not a `ToolTip="..."` attribute or a `<Button.ToolTip>` child element.

rules.title: Wrong root XAML namespace (WPF)
rules.message: The Avalonia default namespace is `https://github.com/avaloniaui`, not the WPF `presentation` namespace.

rules.title: LayoutTransform on a normal element; BitmapEffect
rules.message: `LayoutTransform` exists only on `LayoutTransformControl`: wrap the content in it. `BitmapEffect` does not exist (use `Effect` or `BoxShadow`).

rules.title: WPF window properties AllowsTransparency, WindowStyle, ResizeMode
rules.message: Use `TransparencyLevelHint="Transparent"`, `WindowDecorations="None"` and `CanResize="False"`.

rules.title: RoutedCommand, CommandBinding and CommandManager do not exist
rules.message: Commands are plain `ICommand`s (for example `[RelayCommand]` from CommunityToolkit.Mvvm) bound directly; use `<KeyBinding Gesture="Ctrl+S" Command="{Binding SaveCommand}" />` for shortcuts.

rules.title: WPF/WinUI/MAUI dispatcher APIs do not exist
rules.message: Use `Dispatcher.UIThread.Post` (fire and forget) or `await Dispatcher.UIThread.InvokeAsync(...)`; `Dispatcher.BeginInvoke`, `DispatcherQueue`, `CoreDispatcher` and `MainThread.*` do not exist.

rules.title: Storyboard animations and CompositionTarget.Rendering do not exist
rules.message: Use `Animation` with `KeyFrame`s or `Transitions` (for example `DoubleTransition`), triggered by classes or pseudo-classes; for frame callbacks use `TopLevel.RequestAnimationFrame` instead of `CompositionTarget.Rendering`.

rules.title: pack:// URIs; use avares://
rules.message: Resources are addressed as `avares://AssemblyName/Path`, not `pack://application:,,,/...`.

rules.title: SystemParameters, PresentationSource and WinForms Screen
rules.message: Get screen size and DPI from `TopLevel.GetTopLevel(this)!.Screens` (`Bounds`, `WorkingArea`, `Scaling`).

rules.title: ThemeResource, ElementTheme and AcrylicBrush from WinUI
rules.message: Use `{DynamicResource ...}` instead of `ThemeResource`, `RequestedThemeVariant` instead of `ElementTheme`/`RequestedTheme`, and `ExperimentalAcrylicBorder` instead of `AcrylicBrush`.

rules.title: Controls from WPF/WinUI/MAUI that Avalonia does not have
rules.message: These elements do not exist in Avalonia: StatusBar, RichTextBox, NumberBox (`NumericUpDown`), Pivot (`TabControl`), CalendarView (`Calendar`), FlipView (`Carousel`), ProgressRing (`ProgressBar IsIndeterminate`), ContentDialog (dialog `Window`), InfoBar, TeachingTip, NavigationView, Frame, Entry (`TextBox`), Switch (`ToggleSwitch`), ToolBar.

rules.title: MessageBox.Show is not available
rules.message: Avalonia has no `MessageBox`; build a small dialog `Window` (or use a message box library).

rules.title: Using directives from WPF, WinUI or MAUI UI namespaces
rules.message: References to `Microsoft.Maui`, `Microsoft.UI.Xaml`, `Windows.UI.Xaml` or WPF UI namespaces do not belong in an Avalonia app; remove or abstract them (`System.Windows.Input.ICommand` is fine).

rules.title: RenderingMode list without Software fallback
rules.message: RenderingMode is an ordered fallback list. Without Software at the end the app fails to start or shows an empty window in remote desktop sessions and VMs without a GPU. An empty list throws InvalidOperationException.
rules.good: new Win32PlatformOptions { RenderingMode = new[] { Win32RenderingMode.AngleEgl, Win32RenderingMode.Software } }

rules.title: DPI awareness weakened
rules.message: The default is PerMonitorDpiAware. SystemDpiAware ignores later DPI changes and Unaware makes Windows scale the bitmaps (blurry). A manifest with own DPI entries overrides the setting; declare per-monitor or remove the entries.

rules.title: Manual DPI handling instead of Screen.Scaling
rules.message: Layout uses device independent pixels, so manual DPI conversion is not needed. Read the factor with Screens.ScreenFromWindow(window)?.Scaling.

rules.title: TransparencyLevelHint on a Window without transparent Background
rules.message: TransparencyLevelHint only shows through when Window.Background is Transparent; an opaque background hides it. Mica needs Windows 11, AcrylicBlur Windows 10 1803. Windows can switch transparency off, so keep an opaque fallback based on ActualTransparencyLevel.

rules.title: Custom title bar without ElementRole="TitleBar"
rules.message: When the client area extends into the title bar (ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint="True"), mark the draggable region with WindowDecorationProperties.ElementRole="TitleBar". Only then do window dragging and double-click maximise work.

rules.title: Restored window position not checked against Screens.All
rules.message: Saved window bounds must be checked against the current screens (Screens.All) before they are applied, otherwise the window can open off-screen after a monitor change.
rules.good: apply the saved position only if a screen in Screens.All contains it, else use the default

rules.title: System theme read from the registry
rules.message: Read system theme and accent colour through GetPlatformSettings().GetColorValues() and observe ColorValuesChanged. FluentTheme already follows light and dark.

rules.title: NativeControlHost / NativeWebView limits
rules.message: Native HWND controls (and NativeWebView) always sit above or below Avalonia content, support no transparency or render transforms, and Avalonia overlays (popups, dialogs) cannot cover them. CreateNativeControlCore needs an OperatingSystem.IsWindows() branch and a matching DestroyNativeControlCore.
rules.good: lay the page out without overlapping the native control

rules.title: Custom controls without automation name or peer
rules.message: Built-in controls expose UI Automation peers. Custom controls need AutomationProperties.Name or an overridden OnCreateAutomationPeer. See the fluent2-avalonia skill for depth.

rules.title: #if WINDOWS/LINUX/MACOS in a project without OS-specific TFM
rules.message: WINDOWS, MACOS and similar constants exist only for OS-specific target frameworks (net10.0-windows). In a plain net10.0 project #if WINDOWS is always false, and LINUX is never defined. Use OperatingSystem.IsWindows() at run time, or define the constant on purpose.

rules.title: OnPlatform without Default value
rules.message: {OnPlatform} needs a default (first positional value or Default=), otherwise platforms that are not listed get no value. For object-typed properties such as Tag add x:TypeArguments. OnPlatform does not react to later changes.

rules.title: Bitmap assets without @2x variants
rules.message: For sharp bitmaps on 200 % displays put logo@2x.png next to logo.png; Avalonia picks it from scaling 2.0. Vectors (SVG, StreamGeometry) are not affected.

rules.title: RequestedThemeVariant with an unknown value
rules.message: RequestedThemeVariant is Light, Dark or Default (Default inherits from the parent; System is not a value). Custom variants must be defined explicitly.

rules.title: A closed window cannot be shown again
rules.message: After Close() a window instance cannot be shown again (Show throws). To reuse it, Hide() instead, or create a new instance. Closing the last window ends the app unless ShutdownMode says otherwise.

rules.title: Custom title bar without ElementRole
rules.message: With ExtendClientAreaToDecorationsHint a custom title bar must mark the drag area with WindowDecorationProperties.ElementRole="TitleBar" and interactive elements inside it (menu, search) with ElementRole="User". Ignore if the role is set in another file.

rules.title: WindowDrawnDecorations theme uses ControlTemplate
rules.message: The template of a WindowDrawnDecorations theme is a WindowDrawnDecorationsTemplate with WindowDrawnDecorationsContent (Underlay, Overlay, FullscreenPopover), not a ControlTemplate.

rules.title: Avalonia Pro packages need a license key
rules.message: Charts, PdfViewer, Markdown and RichTextEditor are Avalonia Pro components and need `<AvaloniaUILicenseKey>` in the start project. Set it from an environment variable or an untracked props file, never in the repository.

rules.title: Charts: set IsAnimationEnabled deliberately
rules.message: Chart animation is on by default (`IsAnimationEnabled=true`, 1 s). In reports with many charts per page turn it off on purpose.

rules.title: Charts: bind series data to the ViewModel
rules.message: Series `ItemsSource` should bind to a ViewModel collection (with `CategoryPath` and `ValuePath`), not hold literal data in XAML or code-behind.

rules.title: Charts: series colors from palette or theme resources
rules.message: Hard-coded hex colors on chart series ignore light and dark theme. Use `Palette` or `{DynamicResource ...}` for `Fill` and `Stroke`.

rules.title: Charts: provide a text alternative
rules.message: The docs do not describe UI Automation support for charts. Give each chart an `AutomationProperties.Name` and a data table or summary text next to it.

rules.title: Charts: check the export result
rules.message: Every `ExportAsync` call should evaluate `ChartExportResult.Succeeded`, `Canceled` and `Exception` before using the file.

rules.title: PdfViewer needs its theme included in App.axaml
rules.message: Include `avares://Avalonia.Controls.PdfViewer/Themes/Fluent.axaml` (or `Default.axaml`) in `App.axaml`; without it the PdfViewer does not render.

rules.title: PdfViewer needs the AvaloniaUI.Licensing package in the start project
rules.message: Reference `AvaloniaUI.Licensing` next to `Avalonia.Controls.PdfViewer` in the start project so PDFium and the license come along.

rules.title: PdfViewer: show documents read-only where they must not change
rules.message: A PdfViewer that only displays (receipts, invoices) should set `IsReadOnly="True"` and `AllowDocumentSaving="False"` so users cannot annotate or save changes.

rules.title: PdfViewer: localize the UI strings
rules.message: Without `Strings = new PdfViewerStrings { ... }` the PdfViewer UI stays English. Set the translated strings before the first document loads.
rules.good:
<pdf:PdfViewer Source="{Binding Document}" />
<!-- PdfViewerStrings are set in code -->

rules.title: PdfViewer: page text is not exposed to screen readers
rules.message: Pages render as bitmaps, so PDF text is not exposed to assistive technology. Set `AutomationProperties.Name` on the viewer and offer the text via `GetPageTextAsync` where needed.

rules.title: PdfViewer: custom print path
rules.message: If a custom print route is needed (for example a receipt printer), handle `PrintRequested`, set `e.Handled = true` before the first `await`.

rules.title: Markdown control needs its theme included in App.axaml
rules.message: Include `avares://Avalonia.Controls.Markdown/Themes/Default.axaml` in `App.axaml`; otherwise the Markdown control is unstyled and empty.

rules.title: Markdown: images need an ImageLoader
rules.message: No image loader is set by default, so Markdown images are not shown. Set `ImageLoader`; for `avares://` resources write a custom `MarkdownImageLoader`, since the base loader handles only http, https and file.

rules.title: Markdown inline in XAML needs xml:space="preserve"
rules.message: Markdown written directly as element content loses its line breaks; add `xml:space="preserve"` to the element or bind `Text` to a property.

rules.title: Markdown: theme the link colors through resources
rules.message: Customize with resources like `MarkdownHyperlinkForeground*` or selectors (`RichHyperlink`) for light and dark, not with fixed colors.

rules.title: Markdown subclass needs StyleKeyOverride
rules.message: A subclass of `Markdown` must override `StyleKeyOverride => typeof(Markdown)`, or it gets no default style.

rules.title: Parcel license key or signing password in the repository
rules.message: The Parcel key comes from `AVALONIA_TOOLS_LICENSE_KEY` and signing passwords from `PARCEL_WINDOWS_*` environment variables. Never write them into `.parcel` files or scripts.

rules.title: Parcel Windows installer: set InstallerRequiresAdmin deliberately
rules.message: `InstallerRequiresAdmin` defaults to `true` (installs under Program Files). Set it on purpose.

rules.title: Parcel installer is not signed
rules.message: A shipped installer should be signed (`Win32Settings.SigningType` other than `None`), otherwise Windows SmartScreen warns users.

rules.title: Parcel publish options: test trimming and AOT
rules.message: Set `PublishTrimmed` or `PublishAot` only after testing the Pro controls and any reflection-based libraries (Wolverine, EF).

rules.title: PdfSerializerOptions: set language and title
rules.message: Set `Title` and `Language` (for example `de-AT`) in `PdfSerializerOptions`, and run the export only after Avalonia has started.
rules.bad: var pdf = new PdfSerializer(new PdfSerializerOptions { Title = "Report" });
rules.good: var pdf = new PdfSerializer(new PdfSerializerOptions { Title = "Report", Language = "de-AT" });

rules.title: Property registration naming
rules.message: Declare the field as 'public static readonly ...Property' and register with nameof(Name) so the registered name matches the CLR property (attached properties use a string name and are not flagged).
rules.bad: public static readonly StyledProperty<int> CountProperty = AvaloniaProperty.Register<MyControl, int>("Cnt");
rules.good: public static readonly StyledProperty<int> CountProperty = AvaloniaProperty.Register<MyControl, int>(nameof(Count));

rules.title: Direct property setter bypasses SetAndRaise
rules.message: A direct property setter must call SetAndRaise(XProperty, ref _field, value). Assigning the field directly raises no notification and bindings do not update.
rules.bad:
public static readonly DirectProperty<C, string> StatusProperty = AvaloniaProperty.RegisterDirect<C, string>(nameof(Status), o => o.Status, (o, v) => o.Status = v);
public string Status { get => _status; set { _status = value; } }
rules.good:
public static readonly DirectProperty<C, string> StatusProperty = AvaloniaProperty.RegisterDirect<C, string>(nameof(Status), o => o.Status, (o, v) => o.Status = v);
public string Status { get => _status; set => SetAndRaise(StatusProperty, ref _status, value); }

rules.title: Existing property registered again instead of AddOwner
rules.message: Where another control already defines the property (Background, Foreground, Padding, CornerRadius, Command ...) use Xyz.XyzProperty.AddOwner<T>(). Re-registering creates a second identity and shared styles no longer apply.

rules.title: OverrideDefaultValue/OverrideMetadata outside the static constructor
rules.message: OverrideDefaultValue<T>() and OverrideMetadata<T>() belong in the static constructor of the type; overriding later is undefined behaviour.

rules.title: validate: throws, coerce: without CoerceValue
rules.message: validate: rejects values by throwing and cannot be overridden per type; to clamp use coerce:. When the coercion depends on another property, call CoerceValue(XProperty) from OnPropertyChanged.
rules.bad: validate: v => v >= 0   // value comes from a binding

rules.title: Lifecycle override without base call
rules.message: Overrides of OnLoaded, OnUnloaded, OnInitialized, OnAttachedToVisualTree, OnDetachedFromVisualTree, OnApplyTemplate, OnPropertyChanged and OnDataContextChanged must call base.OnXxx(e), otherwise framework behaviour is lost. Class-wide handlers (XProperty.Changed.AddClassHandler) belong in the static constructor.

rules.title: Attached property without static Get/Set methods
rules.message: RegisterAttached<TOwner, THost, T>("Name") needs static GetName(THost) and SetName(THost, value) so the XAML syntax Owner.Name="..." works.
rules.good: add public static int GetColumn(Control c) and SetColumn(Control c, int v)

rules.title: Inherited property not shared with AddOwner
rules.message: A custom property registered with inherits: true reaches descendants of other types only through AddOwner. Inherited values have the lowest priority.
rules.bad: Register<A, bool>(..., inherits: true) and a child control reads it without AddOwner

rules.title: Local value overrides styles; SetValue instead of SetCurrentValue
rules.message: Priority: animation > local value > style trigger > template > style > inherited. An attribute or binding on the element beats every class or pseudo-class style (also :pointerover). Do not set Background, Foreground or BorderBrush locally where styles must be able to change them. From code, use SetCurrentValue when only the displayed value is updated.
rules.good: set the Background in the Button.primary style

rules.title: Direct property used as style or animation target
rules.message: Direct properties do not take part in styling, animation, value priority, inheritance or coercion and cannot fall back after a style ends. Use a StyledProperty for anything that styles should drive.
rules.bad: AvaloniaProperty.RegisterDirect<MyCtl, IBrush>(...) targeted by a Setter

rules.title: WPF property system types
rules.message: Avalonia has AvaloniaProperty, not DependencyProperty, DependencyObject, PropertyMetadata, FrameworkPropertyMetadata or PropertyChangedCallback.

rules.title: Type-wide template replaced with a Style
rules.message: A Style that sets Template for a whole type stacks on top of the Fluent ControlTheme and cannot replace it. To replace a template use a ControlTheme (x:Key="{x:Type Button}", BasedOn).

rules.title: Derived control does not inherit the base theme
rules.message: Avalonia styles a control by its concrete type. A subclass of Button/TextBox/etc. is unstyled without StyleKeyOverride => typeof(Base) or its own ControlTheme (BasedOn).

rules.title: IStyleable no longer exists
rules.message: IStyleable was removed. Override StyleKeyOverride instead.

rules.title: WPF style pattern (TargetType/x:Key on Style)
rules.message: An Avalonia Style has Selector, not TargetType, and no x:Key. Keyed, typed resources are ControlThemes.

rules.title: Nested style must start with ^
rules.message: A Style nested inside another Style must use the nesting selector: Selector="^:pointerover".

rules.title: Attached property in selector without parentheses
rules.message: Attached properties in a property-match selector need parentheses: [(Grid.Row)=0].

rules.title: Non-existent (WPF/CSS) pseudo-classes
rules.message: Avalonia uses :pointerover, :pressed, :disabled, :focus, :focus-visible, :checked, :selected. :hover, :mouseover, :active, :enabled and :focused do not exist (unless you define them yourself).

rules.title: Focus ring on :focus instead of :focus-visible
rules.message: A visible focus indicator belongs on :focus-visible (keyboard focus) so mouse clicks show no ring; :focus is for states that apply on any focus.

rules.title: Overly broad selectors
rules.message: Selectors like * or :is(Control) without further qualification hit every node in the tree. Target a type plus a class.

rules.title: Style priority: local values, order and proximity
rules.message: Priority follows setter category, then tree proximity, then declaration order, not CSS specificity. Local attributes beat every style (a Classes button with Background= ignores :pointerover). Put base styles before state styles.
rules.good: Base style first, state style after

rules.title: Setter bindings resolve against the styled control
rules.message: Bindings in setters use the DataContext of the styled control, never an Application DataContext. Use DynamicResource for app-wide values; give the Style an x:DataType under compiled bindings.

rules.title: Control instance as shared Setter value
rules.message: A Setter creates its value once for all matching controls. A control instance (Child, Content) must be wrapped in <Template> so each control gets its own copy.

rules.title: State colors on Button-like controls lose to Fluent template parts
rules.message: Fluent themes set Background/BorderBrush of states on the template part ContentPresenter. Target the part: Button:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter.

rules.title: Hard-coded colors instead of DynamicResource
rules.message: Hard-coded colors do not follow light/dark. Take theme-dependent values from DynamicResource (Fluent brushes or your own ThemeDictionaries).

rules.title: Fluent palette keys and ColorPaletteResources
rules.message: FluentTheme palettes exist only for Light and Dark (x:Key="Light"|"Dark"). ThemeDictionaries may also use Default as fallback.

rules.title: StaticResource across StyleInclude files
rules.message: Each StyleInclude file loads in isolation and cannot see keys from sibling includes. Use DynamicResource or define the resource in the same file.
rules.bad: Value="{StaticResource BodyFont}" in TextStyles.axaml (key in Fonts.axaml)

rules.title: StyleInclude before FluentTheme
rules.message: Your own StyleIncludes must come after <FluentTheme /> (later wins). A ResourceDictionary file is included with ResourceInclude, not StyleInclude.

rules.title: FontFamily directly in Application.Resources
rules.message: FontFamily resources declared directly under Application.Resources can vanish through dictionary merging. Use MergedDictionaries or a separate ResourceInclude file.

rules.title: FontFamily="Inter" without a font collection
rules.message: FontFamily="Inter" silently falls back unless Inter is installed. Use fonts:Inter#Inter with .WithInterFont() (Avalonia.Fonts.Inter). Fonts must be AvaloniaResource; variable fonts are unsupported.

rules.title: FontFeatures separator
rules.message: FontFeatures is a comma-separated list of HarfBuzz tags such as +tnum,-calt. Use +tnum for number columns.

rules.title: Font properties on panels and borders
rules.message: Panels and Border have no FontSize/FontWeight/FontFamily/Foreground. Inherit via TextElement.FontSize etc. on the container.

rules.title: Justify without wrapping
rules.message: TextAlignment="Justify" has an effect only with TextWrapping.

rules.title: Repeated inline properties and type scale
rules.message: Repeated attribute combinations belong in a style class; font sizes and weights should come from a type scale (TextBlock.h1/.body/.caption), not scattered literals.

rules.title: Comma in Classes
rules.message: Classes is a space-separated list; commas make one invalid class name. Use kebab-case names.

rules.title: ControlTemplate basics
rules.message: Content-control templates need a ContentPresenter, items-control templates an ItemsPresenter. Chrome properties come via TemplateBinding; writing back requires Mode=TwoWay.

rules.title: Templates must cover interaction states
rules.message: A custom template has to style :pointerover, :pressed, :disabled and :focus-visible itself. Name parts PART_... and fetch them in code via e.NameScope.Find<T>, not FindControl.

rules.title: Slow transition duration
rules.message: Transitions for state changes should last 100-300 ms; longer feels sluggish.

rules.title: Transitions on layout properties
rules.message: Animating Width, Height, Margin or Padding triggers layout every frame. Prefer RenderTransform and Opacity.

rules.title: Style scope and location
rules.message: Global type styles live in App.axaml or an included file; page and component styles stay local and must not leak. Type-wide selectors in Window/UserControl.Styles affect all children.

rules.title: ContainerQuery inside a Style
rules.message: ContainerQuery must be a direct child of a Styles collection or ControlTheme, never inside a Style.

rules.title: Container.Name without Container.Sizing
rules.message: A container query only reacts when a descendant-queried element declares Container.Name and Container.Sizing (Width/Height/Size); the default Normal never matches.

rules.title: Own boolean negation converter
rules.message: Binding syntax supports negation: {Binding !IsOn}. A custom invert-bool converter is unnecessary.

rules.title: Platform service from GetTopLevel without null check
rules.message: TopLevel.GetTopLevel returns null while the control is not in the visual tree (constructor!), and the services can be null too. Use ?. or an is { } pattern.

rules.title: Picker result indexed without checking for cancel
rules.message: Cancelling OpenFilePickerAsync/OpenFolderPickerAsync returns an empty list and SaveFilePickerAsync returns null. Check files.Count (or null) before using the first entry.
rules.good:
var files = await sp.OpenFilePickerAsync(o);
if (files.Count == 0) return;

rules.title: Stream from IStorageFile not disposed
rules.message: Streams from OpenReadAsync/OpenWriteAsync (and readers/writers over them) must be disposed: await using var s = await file.OpenReadAsync().
rules.good: await using var s = await file.OpenReadAsync();

rules.title: IStorageItem.Path used as a file path
rules.message: IStorageItem.Path is not a reliable file path or access proof. Read through OpenReadAsync/OpenWriteAsync; TryGetLocalPath() gives a desktop path (can be null).

rules.title: Wildcard *.* in file type filter
rules.message: Prefer the built-in types (FilePickerFileTypes.All, TextPlain, ImageAll, Pdf). Custom FilePickerFileType patterns are like *.png; do not use *.* (use FilePickerFileTypes.All). SuggestedFileType must be the same instance as an entry of FileTypeFilter/FileTypeChoices.

rules.title: DataTransfer disposed after SetDataAsync
rules.message: The object passed to IClipboard.SetDataAsync must NOT be disposed by the caller; the system disposes it. Conversely, the result of TryGetDataAsync must be disposed (using) and not kept.
rules.bad:
using var data = new DataTransfer();
await clip.SetDataAsync(data);
rules.good:
var data = new DataTransfer();
await clip.SetDataAsync(data);

rules.title: Invalid clipboard application format identifier
rules.message: Identifiers for CreateBytesApplicationFormat/CreateStringApplicationFormat may contain only A-Z a-z 0-9 . and - (no underscore, colon, slash). Platform formats (CreateStringPlatformFormat) are OS-specific and need an OperatingSystem.Is...() guard.

rules.title: Clipboard: read once, flush on exit
rules.message: Several TryGet...Async calls in a row each fetch the data again: call TryGetDataAsync once and read from it. SetDataAsync delivers lazily; to leave data on the clipboard after exit call FlushAsync() before shutting down (Windows and X11).
rules.bad: text, file and bitmap through separate TryGet calls

rules.title: Process.Start for URLs, files or folders
rules.message: Open URLs, files and folders with TopLevel.Launcher (LaunchUriAsync, LaunchFileInfoAsync, LaunchDirectoryInfoAsync); true only means the OS accepted it. Check user-supplied URIs against an allowlist of schemes first.

rules.title: IActivatableLifetime on Windows
rules.message: On Windows IActivatableLifetime does not deliver File, OpenUri, Background or Reopen activation. File associations and protocol launches arrive as command-line arguments (desktop.Args) plus single-instance forwarding (pipe, mutex).

rules.title: Registry or system events for theme and preferences
rules.message: Read system colors and dark mode through GetPlatformSettings()?.GetColorValues() and ColorValuesChanged (null-safe), not through registry queries. Standard gestures in custom controls come from HotkeyConfiguration instead of hard-coded Ctrl+C checks.

rules.title: UI test with [Fact] instead of [AvaloniaFact]
rules.message: With Avalonia.Headless.XUnit, tests that touch controls, windows, layout or input need [AvaloniaFact]/[AvaloniaTheory] (NUnit: [AvaloniaTest]); only those set up the UI thread. Projects with their own UI-thread harness are exempt.
rules.bad: [Fact] public void X() { var w = new Window(); w.Show(); }
rules.good: [AvaloniaFact] public void X() { var w = new Window(); w.Show(); }

rules.title: Headless tests without AvaloniaTestApplication
rules.message: A test project with [AvaloniaFact] tests needs exactly one [assembly: AvaloniaTestApplication(typeof(TestAppBuilder))] with BuildAvaloniaApp() => AppBuilder.Configure<App>().UseHeadless(...). The test App needs a theme (FluentTheme).

rules.title: PerAssembly isolation shares state and forbids parallel runs
rules.message: AvaloniaTestIsolationLevel.PerAssembly is faster but shares application state between tests: reset styles, resources, statics and culture, and disable xUnit parallelization (headless tests cannot run in parallel).

rules.title: Click simulated with RaiseEvent(ClickEvent)
rules.message: RaiseEvent(ClickEvent) does not execute bound commands. Simulate input: window.MouseDown/MouseUp at a point inside the button, or Focus() plus KeyReleaseQwerty(PhysicalKey.Space). The window must be shown first.

rules.title: Waiting for UI with Delay or Sleep in tests
rules.message: Flush layout and dispatcher jobs with Dispatcher.UIThread.RunJobs() and render time with AvaloniaHeadlessPlatform.ForceRenderTimerTick() instead of Task.Delay or Thread.Sleep. Timer-logic tests without UI may wait.

rules.title: CaptureRenderedFrame without Skia and real drawing
rules.message: CaptureRenderedFrame() returns real pixels only with .UseSkia() and UseHeadlessDrawing = false (the default is a fake renderer). Compare against baselines with a tolerance and load baselines from the output directory.
rules.good:
var bmp = window.CaptureRenderedFrame();
AppBuilder.Configure<App>().UseSkia().UseHeadless(new AvaloniaHeadlessPlatformOptions { UseHeadlessDrawing = false });

rules.title: DiagnosticsSupport and its start call not limited to Debug
rules.message: Exclude the developer tools from production for security and size: condition the PackageReference on '$(Configuration)' == 'Debug' and wrap AttachDeveloperTools()/WithDeveloperTools() in #if DEBUG.

rules.title: DiagnosticsSupport referenced but never started
rules.message: Without this.AttachDeveloperTools() (in App.Initialize, after AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load) or .WithDeveloperTools() on the AppBuilder the library is never initialised: F12 does nothing and the MCP attach fails.

rules.title: Avalonia packages with different versions
rules.message: All Avalonia packages must share one version, otherwise tools (breakpoints, property edits) and runtime behave unpredictably. Keep the versions in one place (Directory.Packages.props).

rules.title: Avalonia licence key committed to the repository
rules.message: The key for AvaloniaUILicenseKey (and AVALONIA_TOOLS_LICENSE_KEY / AVALONIA_LICENSE_KEY for MCP) must stay out of committed files. Read it from an environment variable or a props file that is not checked in.

rules.title: App startup code runs in the XAML previewer
rules.message: The XAML previewer starts the app process without a real windowing system and runs App startup code. Guard database, network and service starts with Design.IsDesignMode.

rules.title: DataTemplate in a DataTemplates collection without DataType
rules.message: A DataTemplate inside a DataTemplates collection is selected by type. Without DataType it never matches and the object shows up as ToString().

rules.title: ItemTemplate/ContentTemplate DataTemplate without x:DataType
rules.message: Inside item and content templates the data type is the item type, not the surrounding x:DataType. Without its own x:DataType the compiler resolves bindings against the wrong type (build error or wrong binding).

rules.title: Reflection-based ViewLocator
rules.message: The default ViewLocator (Type.GetType + Activator.CreateInstance) is not AOT or trimming safe and has no compile-time safety. Use a switch pattern, XAML DataTemplates, DI or a source generator.
rules.good: return data switch { MainViewModel => new MainView(), _ => new TextBlock { Text = "Not found" } };

rules.title: Duplicate DataTemplates for one DataType
rules.message: Templates are searched from the control up through parents, Window and Application; the first match wins. Two templates for the same DataType on different levels override each other silently.
rules.bad: DataTemplate DataType="vm:Customer" in App.axaml and in MainWindow.axaml
rules.good: keep one, or document the intended local override

rules.title: Non-control content without a matching template
rules.message: A bound object that is not a Control and has no matching DataTemplate/IDataTemplate is shown as its ToString() (full class name). Every Content="{Binding SomeViewModel}" needs a DataType template or a ViewLocator.Match branch.
rules.bad: <ContentControl Content="{Binding CurrentPage}"/> with no template for SettingsViewModel

rules.title: ListBox used for a list without selection
rules.message: Without selection use ItemsControl: no selection highlight and no keyboard navigation overhead. Keep ListBox when keyboard navigation is wanted.

rules.title: Large list without virtualization
rules.message: Large lists must virtualize so only visible items are rendered. An ItemsControl with the default or a StackPanel ItemsPanel, or inside a ScrollViewer, does not virtualize. Use ListBox or a virtualizing panel.

rules.title: Deep or redundant visual tree
rules.message: Every element goes through measure and arrange. Collapse wrappers that add nothing (Border in Border, a Grid with one child). The DevTools elements tree shows the extra levels.

rules.title: PathGeometry instead of StreamGeometry
rules.message: StreamGeometry needs less memory and is faster; the path mini-language (Data="M0,0 L10,10") creates one. Use PathGeometry only for figures that are modified or animated.

rules.title: Thumbnails decoded at full size
rules.message: Avalonia decodes images at full size by default. For thumbnails in lists use downscaled files or decode to a smaller width (Bitmap.DecodeToWidth).

rules.title: Selector without any target fails silently
rules.message: A selector that matches no control produces neither error nor warning; the style is just missing. Check that every #name and .class used in a selector exists (typos, classes set only at run time).

rules.title: Button pseudo-class setter on Background has no effect
rules.message: In the Fluent template a ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter draws the background and the pointer-over state sets its Background directly. Button:pointerover with a Background or BorderBrush setter does nothing; target 'Button:pointerover /template/ ContentPresenter#PART_ContentPresenter' instead.

rules.title: ControlTheme without TargetType or with mismatching key
rules.message: A ControlTheme is only found when x:Key ({x:Type Button} for default themes) and TargetType match the control and the file is included through StyleInclude or ResourceInclude. A missing TargetType or a wrong key silently does nothing.

rules.title: Broad type selectors hit template internals
rules.message: Style Selector="TextBlock" matches every TextBlock, including those inside ListBox items and button labels. Narrow with a class (TextBlock.heading), a name or context. Base-class selectors (Control, TemplatedControl) cause many failed match attempts.

rules.title: App.axaml without a base theme
rules.message: Without FluentTheme or SimpleTheme (or a third-party theme) controls have no templates and the window stays empty or transparent.

rules.title: NumericUpDown Value binding without TargetNullValue
rules.message: Clearing the text of a NumericUpDown can throw 'Invalid cast from string to decimal?'. Give the Value binding a TargetNullValue (typed like the source, e.g. x:Decimal) and optionally UpdateSourceTrigger=LostFocus.

rules.title: Pseudo-classes set without [PseudoClasses] attribute
rules.message: A custom control that sets pseudo-classes with PseudoClasses.Set(":x", ...) should declare [PseudoClasses(":x")] for DevTools and IDE completion.

rules.title: avares:// URI does not match assembly name or AvaloniaResource
rules.message: Asset URIs have the form avares://AssemblyName/Path. Assembly name and path must match the embedded AvaloniaResource items.

rules.title: clr-namespace: instead of using:
rules.message: The using: syntax is shorter and needs no ;assembly=. Prefer xmlns:vm="using:MyApp.ViewModels".

rules.title: d: attributes without mc:Ignorable="d"
rules.message: Design-time attributes (d:DesignWidth, d:DataContext) need xmlns:d, xmlns:mc and mc:Ignorable="d" on the root, otherwise they fail to resolve at run time.

rules.title: FindControl with a literal name instead of the x:Name field
rules.message: x:Name generates a field on the partial class, so this.FindControl<T>("Name") is not needed for names known at build time.

rules.title: Shared resource instance that can have only one parent
rules.message: Resources are singletons by default. Instances that may have only one parent (ColumnDefinitions, RowDefinitions, controls, panels) need x:Shared="False", otherwise the second use fails.

rules.title: TemplateBinding with an unsupported mode
rules.message: TemplateBinding supports only OneWay (default) and TwoWay. Use TwoWay, or the long form RelativeSource TemplatedParent when more options are needed.

rules.title: StaticResource for theme-dependent brushes and colours
rules.message: StaticResource resolves once at load, does not follow a Light/Dark theme switch and throws when the key is missing. Reference theme-dependent brushes, colours and sizes with DynamicResource. Also check that every referenced key exists.

rules.title: NoWarn hides Avalonia XAML compiler diagnostics
rules.message: The XAML compiler reports [Obsolete] and [Experimental] usage (AVLN codes). Silencing those codes hides outdated API use. Fix the warning or suppress a single deliberate code with a comment.
rules.good: <!-- fix the obsolete member instead of suppressing AVLN2001 -->

rules.title: WPF validation remnants in XAML
rules.message: Avalonia uses IsVisible (bool), not Visibility="Collapsed" or a visibility converter. Validation runs through INotifyDataErrorInfo, not Validation.ErrorTemplate, ValidatesOnDataErrors, ValidatesOnExceptions or NotifyOnValidationError.

rules.title: Native AOT or trimming with reflection bindings
rules.message: With PublishAot or PublishTrimmed, compiled bindings must be on, every binding needs x:DataType, and no ReflectionBinding or reflection ViewLocator may remain. Treat AV-BIND-02, AV-BIND-03 and AV-TPL-03 as errors in such projects.
